Require Export fintype.

Inductive valtype  : Type :=
  | zero : valtype
  | one : valtype
  | U : comptype  -> valtype
  | Sigma : valtype  -> valtype  -> valtype
  | cross : valtype  -> valtype  -> valtype
 with comptype  : Type :=
  | cone : comptype
  | F : valtype  -> comptype
  | Pi : comptype  -> comptype  -> comptype
  | arrow : valtype  -> comptype  -> comptype .

Inductive value (nvalue : nat) : Type :=
  | var_value : fin (nvalue) -> value (nvalue)
  | u : value (nvalue)
  | pair : value (nvalue) -> value (nvalue) -> value (nvalue)
  | inj : bool  -> value (nvalue) -> value (nvalue)
  | thunk : comp (nvalue) -> value (nvalue)
 with comp (nvalue : nat) : Type :=
  | cu : comp (nvalue)
  | force : value (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | lambda : comp (S nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | app : comp (nvalue) -> value (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | tuple : comp (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | ret : value (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | letin : comp (nvalue) -> comp (S nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | proj : bool  -> comp (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | caseZ : value (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | caseS : value (nvalue) -> comp (S nvalue) -> comp (S nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | caseP : value (nvalue) -> comp (S (S nvalue)) -> comp (nvalue).

Definition upRen_value_value { m : nat } { n : nat } (xi : fin (m) -> fin (n)) : _ :=
  up_ren xi.

Fixpoint ren_value { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (xivalue : fin (mvalue) -> fin (nvalue)) (s : value (mvalue)) : _ :=
    match s with
    | var_value (_) s => (var_value (nvalue)) (xivalue s)
    | u (_)  => u (nvalue)
    | pair (_) s0 s1 => pair (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0) (ren_value xivalue s1)
    | inj (_) s0 s1 => inj (nvalue) s0 (ren_value xivalue s1)
    | thunk (_) s0 => thunk (nvalue) (ren_comp xivalue s0)
    end
 with ren_comp { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (xivalue : fin (mvalue) -> fin (nvalue)) (s : comp (mvalue)) : _ :=
    match s with
    | cu (_)  => cu (nvalue)
    | force (_) s0 => force (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0)
    | lambda (_) s0 => lambda (nvalue) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value xivalue) s0)
    | app (_) s0 s1 => app (nvalue) (ren_comp xivalue s0) (ren_value xivalue s1)
    | tuple (_) s0 s1 => tuple (nvalue) (ren_comp xivalue s0) (ren_comp xivalue s1)
    | ret (_) s0 => ret (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0)
    | letin (_) s0 s1 => letin (nvalue) (ren_comp xivalue s0) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value xivalue) s1)
    | proj (_) s0 s1 => proj (nvalue) s0 (ren_comp xivalue s1)
    | caseZ (_) s0 => caseZ (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0)
    | caseS (_) s0 s1 s2 => caseS (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value xivalue) s1) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value xivalue) s2)
    | caseP (_) s0 s1 => caseP (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value (upRen_value_value xivalue)) s1)
    end.

Definition up_value_value { m : nat } { nvalue : nat } (sigma : fin (m) -> value (nvalue)) : _ :=
  scons ((var_value (S nvalue)) var_zero) (funcomp (ren_value shift) sigma).

Fixpoint subst_value { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (sigmavalue : fin (mvalue) -> value (nvalue)) (s : value (mvalue)) : _ :=
    match s with
    | var_value (_) s => sigmavalue s
    | u (_)  => u (nvalue)
    | pair (_) s0 s1 => pair (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0) (subst_value sigmavalue s1)
    | inj (_) s0 s1 => inj (nvalue) s0 (subst_value sigmavalue s1)
    | thunk (_) s0 => thunk (nvalue) (subst_comp sigmavalue s0)
    end
 with subst_comp { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (sigmavalue : fin (mvalue) -> value (nvalue)) (s : comp (mvalue)) : _ :=
    match s with
    | cu (_)  => cu (nvalue)
    | force (_) s0 => force (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0)
    | lambda (_) s0 => lambda (nvalue) (subst_comp (up_value_value sigmavalue) s0)
    | app (_) s0 s1 => app (nvalue) (subst_comp sigmavalue s0) (subst_value sigmavalue s1)
    | tuple (_) s0 s1 => tuple (nvalue) (subst_comp sigmavalue s0) (subst_comp sigmavalue s1)
    | ret (_) s0 => ret (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0)
    | letin (_) s0 s1 => letin (nvalue) (subst_comp sigmavalue s0) (subst_comp (up_value_value sigmavalue) s1)
    | proj (_) s0 s1 => proj (nvalue) s0 (subst_comp sigmavalue s1)
    | caseZ (_) s0 => caseZ (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0)
    | caseS (_) s0 s1 s2 => caseS (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0) (subst_comp (up_value_value sigmavalue) s1) (subst_comp (up_value_value sigmavalue) s2)
    | caseP (_) s0 s1 => caseP (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0) (subst_comp (up_value_value (up_value_value sigmavalue)) s1)
    end.

Arguments var_value {nvalue}.

Arguments u {nvalue}.

Arguments pair {nvalue}.

Arguments inj {nvalue}.

Arguments thunk {nvalue}.

Arguments cu {nvalue}.

Arguments force {nvalue}.

Arguments lambda {nvalue}.

Arguments app {nvalue}.

Arguments tuple {nvalue}.

Arguments ret {nvalue}.

Arguments letin {nvalue}.

Arguments proj {nvalue}.

Arguments caseZ {nvalue}.

Arguments caseS {nvalue}.

Arguments caseP {nvalue}.

Instance Subst_value : Subst1 value value := @subst_value .

Instance Subst_comp : Subst1 value comp := @subst_comp .

Instance Ren_value : Ren1 value := @ren_value .

Instance Ren_comp : Ren1 comp := @ren_comp .

Instance VarInstance_value : Var value := @var_value .

Notation "x '__value'" := (@ids value VarInstance_value (_) x) (at level 30, format "x __value") : subst_scope.

Notation "⇑__value" := (@up_value_value (_)) (only printing) : subst_scope.
=== Terms.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export Syntax Base AbstractReductionSystems.

Scheme value_ind_2 := Induction for value Sort Prop
  with comp_ind_2  := Induction for comp Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_val_comp from value_ind_2, comp_ind_2.

Inductive valtype : Type :=
| zero: valtype
| one: valtype
| U: comptype -> valtype
| Sigma: valtype -> valtype -> valtype
| cross: valtype -> valtype -> valtype


with comptype : Type :=
| cone: comptype
| F: valtype -> comptype
| Pi: comptype -> comptype -> comptype
| arrow: valtype -> comptype -> comptype.

Scheme valtype_ind_2 := Induction for valtype Sort Prop
  with comptype_ind_2  := Induction for comptype Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_valtype_comptype from valtype_ind_2, comptype_ind_2.

Inductive groundtype : Type :=
| gone : groundtype
| gsum : groundtype -> groundtype -> groundtype
| gcross : groundtype -> groundtype -> groundtype.

Fixpoint to_valtype (G: groundtype) :=
  match G with
  | gone => one
  | gsum G1 G2 => Sigma (to_valtype  G1) (to_valtype  G2)
  | gcross G1 G2 => cross (to_valtype  G1) (to_valtype  G2)
  end.

Coercion to_valtype: groundtype >-> valtype.

Fixpoint nat_to_fin {m: nat} (n: nat)  : fin (S (it S n m)) :=
  match n with
  | O => var_zero
  | S n => Some (nat_to_fin n)
  end.

Definition var {m: nat} (n: nat) : value (S (it S n m)) :=
  var_value (nat_to_fin n).

Notation "<{ c }>" := (thunk c).

Notation "c !" := (force c) (at level 50).

Notation "$ <- A ; B" := (letin A B) (at level 55).

Notation "⟨ A ; B ⟩" := (pair A B) (at level 52).

Notation "A → B" := (arrow A B) (at level 53).

Notation "A * B" := (cross A B).

Coercion app : comp >-> Funclass.
=== Semantics.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.Terms CBPV.Base CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems.

Import CommaNotation.

Reserved Notation "A '≽' B" (at level 80).

Reserved Notation "A '⇝' B" (at level 80).

Inductive pstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| pstepForce (c: comp n):
    <{c}>! ≽ c
| pstepApp (c: comp (S n)) (c': comp n) v:
    c[v..] = c' -> (lambda c) v ≽ c'
| pstepProj (b: bool) (c c1 c2: comp n) :
    (c = if b then c1 else c2) -> proj b (tuple c1 c2) ≽ c
| pstepLetin (c: comp (S n)) c' v:
    c[v..] = c' -> $ <- (ret v); c ≽ c'
| pstepCaseS v (b: bool) c (c1 c2: comp (S n)):
    (if b then c1 else c2)[v..] = c -> caseS (inj b v) c1 c2 ≽ c
| pstepCaseP v1 v2 (c: comp (S (S n))) c':
    c[v2,v1..] = c' -> caseP (pair v1 v2) c ≽ c'
where "A '≽' B" := (pstep A B).

Inductive step {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| stepPrimitive (c c': comp n) : c ≽ c' -> c > c'
| stepApp (c c': comp n) v: c > c' -> c v > c' v
| stepProj (c c': comp n)  b: c > c' -> proj b c > proj b c'
| stepLetin (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 > c1' -> $ <- c1; c2 > $ <- c1'; c2
where "A > B" := (step A B).

Notation "A >* B" := (star step A B) (at level 60).

Notation "A >+ B" := (plus step A B) (at level 60).

Inductive ectx {n: nat}: Type :=
| ectxHole : ectx
| ectxApp : ectx -> value n -> ectx
| ectxProj : bool -> ectx -> ectx
| ectxLetin : ectx -> comp (S n) -> ectx.

Fixpoint fill {n: nat} (K: ectx) (c: comp n) :=
  match K with
  | ectxHole => c
  | ectxApp K v => (fill K c) v
  | ectxProj b K => proj b (fill K c)
  | ectxLetin K c' => letin (fill K c) c'
  end.

Inductive cstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| contextStep C c c' (c'' c''': comp n):
    c ≽ c' -> fill C c = c'' -> fill C c' = c''' -> c'' ⇝ c'''
where "A '⇝' B" := (cstep A B).

Reserved Notation "A ▷ B" (at level 80).

Inductive bigstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| bigstepCu: @cu n ▷ cu
| bigstepReturn (v: value n) : ret v ▷ ret v
| bigstepLambda (c: comp (S n)) : lambda c ▷ lambda c
| bigstepTuple (c1 c2: comp n): tuple c1 c2 ▷ tuple c1 c2
| bigstepForce (c c': comp n): c ▷ c' -> <{c}>! ▷ c'
| bigstepApp (c c'': comp n) c' v: c ▷ lambda c' -> c'[v..] ▷ c'' -> c v ▷ c''
| bigstepProj c c' (c1 c2: comp n) (b: bool):
    c ▷ tuple c1 c2 -> (if b then c1 else c2) ▷ c' -> proj b c ▷ c'
| bigstepLetin c1 (v: value n) c2 c: c1 ▷ ret v -> c2[v..] ▷ c -> $ <- c1; c2 ▷ c
| bigstepCaseS c c1 c2 (b: bool) (v: value n):
    (if b then c1 else c2)[v..] ▷ c -> caseS (inj b v) c1 c2 ▷ c
| bigstepCaseP c c' (v1 v2: value n):
    c[v2,v1..] ▷ c' -> caseP (pair v1 v2) c ▷ c'
where "A ▷ B" := (bigstep A B).

Inductive nf {n: nat}: comp n -> Prop :=
| nfCu: nf cu
| nfLam c: nf (lambda c)
| nfTup c1 c2: nf (tuple c1 c2)
| nfRet v: nf (ret v).

Definition eval {n: nat} (c c': comp n) := c >* c' /\ nf c'.

Fixpoint ren_value { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (xivalue : fin (mvalue) -> fin (nvalue)) (s : value (mvalue)) : _ :=

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export Syntax Base AbstractReductionSystems.

Scheme value_ind_2 := Induction for value Sort Prop
  with comp_ind_2  := Induction for comp Sort Prop.

Inductive valtype : Type :=
| zero: valtype
| one: valtype
| U: comptype -> valtype
| Sigma: valtype -> valtype -> valtype
| cross: valtype -> valtype -> valtype


with comptype : Type :=
| cone: comptype
| F: valtype -> comptype
| Pi: comptype -> comptype -> comptype

Inductive groundtype : Type :=
| gone : groundtype
| gsum : groundtype -> groundtype -> groundtype
| gcross : groundtype -> groundtype -> groundtype.

Fixpoint to_valtype (G: groundtype) :=
  match G with
  | gone => one
  | gsum G1 G2 => Sigma (to_valtype  G1) (to_valtype  G2)
  | gcross G1 G2 => cross (to_valtype  G1) (to_valtype  G2)
  end.

Coercion to_valtype: groundtype >-> valtype.

Fixpoint nat_to_fin {m: nat} (n: nat)  : fin (S (it S n m)) :=
  match n with
  | O => var_zero
  | S n => Some (nat_to_fin n)
  end.

Definition var {m: nat} (n: nat) : value (S (it S n m)) :=
  var_value (nat_to_fin n).

Notation "<{ c }>" := (thunk c).

Notation "c !" := (force c) (at level 50).

Notation "$ <- A ; B" := (letin A B) (at level 55).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.Terms CBPV.Base CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems.

Import CommaNotation.

Reserved Notation "A '≽' B" (at level 80).

Reserved Notation "A '⇝' B" (at level 80).

Inductive pstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| pstepForce (c: comp n):
    <{c}>! ≽ c
| pstepApp (c: comp (S n)) (c': comp n) v:
    c[v..] = c' -> (lambda c) v ≽ c'
| pstepProj (b: bool) (c c1 c2: comp n) :
    (c = if b then c1 else c2) -> proj b (tuple c1 c2) ≽ c
| pstepLetin (c: comp (S n)) c' v:
    c[v..] = c' -> $ <- (ret v); c ≽ c'
| pstepCaseS v (b: bool) c (c1 c2: comp (S n)):
    (if b then c1 else c2)[v..] = c -> caseS (inj b v) c1 c2 ≽ c
| pstepCaseP v1 v2 (c: comp (S (S n))) c':
    c[v2,v1..] = c' -> caseP (pair v1 v2) c ≽ c'
where "A '≽' B" := (pstep A B).

Inductive step {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| stepPrimitive (c c': comp n) : c ≽ c' -> c > c'
| stepApp (c c': comp n) v: c > c' -> c v > c' v
| stepProj (c c': comp n)  b: c > c' -> proj b c > proj b c'
| stepLetin (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 > c1' -> $ <- c1; c2 > $ <- c1'; c2
where "A > B" := (step A B).

Notation "A >* B" := (star step A B) (at level 60).

Notation "A >+ B" := (plus step A B) (at level 60).

Inductive ectx {n: nat}: Type :=
| ectxHole : ectx
| ectxApp : ectx -> value n -> ectx
| ectxProj : bool -> ectx -> ectx
| ectxLetin : ectx -> comp (S n) -> ectx.

Fixpoint fill {n: nat} (K: ectx) (c: comp n) :=
  match K with
  | ectxHole => c
  | ectxApp K v => (fill K c) v
  | ectxProj b K => proj b (fill K c)
  | ectxLetin K c' => letin (fill K c) c'
  end.

Inductive cstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| contextStep C c c' (c'' c''': comp n):
    c ≽ c' -> fill C c = c'' -> fill C c' = c''' -> c'' ⇝ c'''
where "A '⇝' B" := (cstep A B).

Reserved Notation "A ▷ B" (at level 80).

Inductive bigstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| bigstepCu: @cu n ▷ cu
| bigstepReturn (v: value n) : ret v ▷ ret v
| bigstepLambda (c: comp (S n)) : lambda c ▷ lambda c
| bigstepTuple (c1 c2: comp n): tuple c1 c2 ▷ tuple c1 c2
| bigstepForce (c c': comp n): c ▷ c' -> <{c}>! ▷ c'
| bigstepApp (c c'': comp n) c' v: c ▷ lambda c' -> c'[v..] ▷ c'' -> c v ▷ c''
| bigstepProj c c' (c1 c2: comp n) (b: bool):
    c ▷ tuple c1 c2 -> (if b then c1 else c2) ▷ c' -> proj b c ▷ c'
| bigstepLetin c1 (v: value n) c2 c: c1 ▷ ret v -> c2[v..] ▷ c -> $ <- c1; c2 ▷ c
| bigstepCaseS c c1 c2 (b: bool) (v: value n):
    (if b then c1 else c2)[v..] ▷ c -> caseS (inj b v) c1 c2 ▷ c
| bigstepCaseP c c' (v1 v2: value n):
    c[v2,v1..] ▷ c' -> caseP (pair v1 v2) c ▷ c'
where "A ▷ B" := (bigstep A B).

Inductive nf {n: nat}: comp n -> Prop :=
| nfCu: nf cu
| nfLam c: nf (lambda c)
| nfTup c1 c2: nf (tuple c1 c2)
| nfRet v: nf (ret v).

Definition eval {n: nat} (c c': comp n) := c >* c' /\ nf c'.

=== AbstractReductionSystems.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Morphisms FinFun Base.

Notation "R <<= S" := (forall x y, R x y -> S x y) (at level 70).

Notation "R === S" := (R <<= S /\ S <<= R) (at level 70).

Section ClosureRelations.

Variables (X: Type) (R: X -> X -> Prop).

Implicit Types x y z : X.

Definition functional := forall x y z, R x y -> R x z -> y = z.

Inductive star : X -> X -> Prop :=
  | starRefl x     : star x x
  | starStep x x' y : R x x' -> star x' y -> star x y.

Inductive plus : X -> X -> Prop :=
  | plusSingle x y: R x y -> plus x y
  | plusStep x x' y: R x x' -> plus x' y -> plus x y.

Inductive counted : nat -> X -> X -> Prop :=
  | countedRefl x: counted 0 x x
  | countedStep x x' y n: R x x' -> counted n x' y -> counted (S n) x y.

Inductive sym: X -> X -> Prop :=
  | symId x y: R x y -> sym x y
  | symInv x y: R y x -> sym x y.

End ClosureRelations.

Definition equiv X (R: X -> X -> Prop) := star (sym R).

Section Properties.

Variable X: Type.

Implicit Types (x y z : X) (R S : X -> X -> Prop).

End Properties.

Section StrongNormalisation.

Variables (X A: Type).

Variables (R: X -> X -> Prop) (S: A -> A -> Prop).

Definition Normal x := forall y, ~ R x y.

Definition evaluates s t := star R s t /\ Normal t.

Inductive SN {X} (R: X -> X -> Prop) : X -> Prop :=
  | SNC x : (forall y, R x y -> SN R y) -> SN R x.

Definition morphism  (f: X -> A) := forall x y, R x  y -> S (f x) (f y).

End StrongNormalisation.

Section Confluence.

Variable X: Type.

Implicit Types (x y z : X) (R S : X -> X -> Prop).

Definition joinable R x y := exists2 z, R x z & R y z.

Definition diamond R := forall x y z, R x y -> R x z -> joinable R y z.

Definition confluent R := diamond (star R).

Definition semi_confluent R :=
    forall x y z, R x y -> star R x z -> joinable (star R) y z.

End Confluence.

Inductive starL {X: Type} (R: X -> X -> Prop) (x : X):  X -> Prop :=
| starReflL : starL R x x
| starStepL  y y':  starL R x y -> R y y' -> starL R x y'.
=== StrongReduction.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.ProgramContexts CBPV.Semantics.

Import CommaNotation.

Reserved Notation "C1 ⇒ C2" (at level 60).

Reserved Notation "V1 ⇒ᵥ V2" (at level 60).

Inductive strong_step {n: nat} : comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| strong_reduce  m (c1 c2: comp m) (K: cctx false n m):
    c1 ≽ c2 -> fillc K c1 ⇒ fillc K c2
where "C1 ⇒ C2" := (strong_step C1 C2).

Inductive strong_step_value {n : nat} : value n -> value n -> Prop :=
| strong_reduce_value k (c1 c2 : comp k) (K : vctx false n k) :
    c1 ≽ c2 -> fillv K c1 ⇒ᵥ fillv K c2
where "V1 ⇒ᵥ V2" := (strong_step_value V1 V2).

Reserved Notation "C1 ↪ C2" (at level 60).

Reserved Notation "V1 ↪ᵥ V2" (at level 60).

Inductive sstep {n: nat} : comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| sstepForce (v v': value n): v ↪ᵥ v' -> v ! ↪ v' !
| sstepLambda (c c': comp (S n)): c ↪ c' -> lambda c ↪ lambda c'
| sstepAppL (c c': comp n) v: c ↪ c' -> c v ↪ c' v
| sstepAppR (c: comp n) (v v': value n): v ↪ᵥ v' -> c v ↪ c v'
| sstepTupleL (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 ↪ c1' -> tuple c1 c2 ↪ tuple c1' c2
| sstepTupleR c1 (c2 c2': comp n): c2 ↪ c2' -> tuple c1 c2 ↪ tuple c1 c2'
| sstepRet (v v': value n): v ↪ᵥ v' -> ret v ↪ ret v'
| sstepLetinL (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 ↪ c1' -> letin c1 c2 ↪ letin c1' c2
| sstepLetinR c1 (c2 c2': comp (S n)): c2 ↪ c2' -> letin c1 c2 ↪ letin c1 c2'
| sstepProj (c c': comp n) b: c ↪ c' -> proj b c ↪ proj b c'
| sstepCaseZ (v v': value n): v ↪ᵥ v' -> caseZ v ↪ caseZ v'
| sstepCaseSV (v v': value n) c1 c2: v ↪ᵥ v' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v' c1 c2
| sstepCaseSL (v: value n) c1 c1' c2: c1 ↪ c1' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v c1' c2
| sstepCaseSR (v: value n) c1 c2 c2': c2 ↪ c2' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v c1 c2'
| sstepCasePV (v v': value n) c: v ↪ᵥ v' -> caseP v c ↪ caseP v' c
| sstepCasePC (v: value n) c c': c ↪ c' -> caseP v c ↪ caseP v c'
| sstepPrimitive (c c': comp n) : c ≽ c' -> c ↪ c'
where "C1 ↪ C2" := (@sstep _ C1 C2)
with sstep_value {n: nat} : value n -> value n -> Prop :=
| sstepValuePairL (v1 v1' v2: value n) : v1 ↪ᵥ v1' -> pair v1 v2 ↪ᵥ pair v1' v2
| sstepValuePairR (v1 v2 v2': value n) : v2 ↪ᵥ v2' -> pair v1 v2 ↪ᵥ pair v1 v2'
| sstepValueInj b (v v': value n) : v ↪ᵥ v' -> inj b v ↪ᵥ inj b v'
| sstepValueThunk (c c': comp n) : c ↪ c' -> <{ c }> ↪ᵥ <{ c' }>
where "V1 ↪ᵥ V2" := (@sstep_value _ V1 V2).

Scheme sstep_value_ind_2 := Induction for sstep_value Sort Prop
  with sstep_ind_2  := Induction for sstep Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_sstep from sstep_ind_2, sstep_value_ind_2.

Notation "M ↪* N" := (star sstep M N) (at level 60).

Notation "M ↪ᵥ* N" := (star sstep_value M N) (at level 60).
=== ObservationalEquivalence.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.ProgramContexts.

Record CBPVv {n: nat} (Gamma: ctx n) (A: valtype) :=
  mkCBPVv { CBPVv_v :> value n; CBPVv_H :> Gamma ⊩ CBPVv_v : A }.

Record CBPVc {n: nat} (Gamma: ctx n) (B: comptype) :=
  mkCBPVc { CBPVc_c :> comp n; CBPVc_H :> Gamma ⊢ CBPVc_c : B }.

Definition value_obseq {n: nat} {A: valtype} {Gamma: ctx n} (H1 H2: CBPVv Gamma A) :=
  forall (G: groundtype) (C: cctx true 0 n),
    null [[Gamma]] ⊢ C : F G; A -> forall v, (fillc C H1 >* ret v) <-> (fillc C H2 >* ret v).

Notation "V1 ≈ V2" := (value_obseq V1 V2) (at level 50).

Definition comp_obseq {n: nat} {B: comptype} {Gamma: ctx n} (H1 H2: CBPVc Gamma B) :=
  forall (G: groundtype) (C: cctx false 0 n),
    null [[Gamma]] ⊢ C : F G; B -> forall v, (fillc C H1 >* ret v) <-> (fillc C H2 >* ret v).

Notation "C1 ≃ C2" := (comp_obseq C1 C2) (at level 50).
=== SyntacticTyping.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.Terms CBPV.Base CBPV.Semantics.

Import CommaNotation.

Reserved Notation "Gamma ⊢ c : A" (at level 80, c at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Gamma ⊩ v : A" (at level 80, v at level 99).

Definition ctx (n: nat) := fin n -> valtype.

Inductive value_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : value m -> valtype -> Type :=
| typeVar i : Gamma ⊩ var_value i : Gamma i
| typeUnit: Gamma ⊩ u : one
| typePair v1 v2 A1 A2:
    Gamma ⊩ v1 : A1 -> Gamma ⊩ v2 : A2 -> Gamma ⊩ pair v1 v2 : cross A1 A2
| typeSum A1 A2 (b: bool) v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : (if b then A1 else A2) -> Gamma ⊩ inj b v : Sigma A1 A2
| typeThunk c A:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A -> Gamma ⊩ thunk c : U A
where "Gamma ⊩ v : A" := (value_typing Gamma v A)


with computation_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : comp m -> comptype -> Type :=
| typeCone: Gamma ⊢ cu : cone
| typeLambda (c: comp (S m)) A B:
    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B -> (Gamma ⊢ lambda c : A → B)
| typeLetin c1 c2 A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : F A -> A .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B -> Gamma ⊢ $ <- c1; c2 : B
| typeRet v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ ret v : F A
| typeApp c v A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B -> Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ c v : B
| typeTuple c1 c2 B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : B1  -> Gamma ⊢ c2 : B2 -> Gamma ⊢ tuple c1 c2 : Pi B1 B2
| typeProj b c B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c : Pi B1 B2 -> Gamma ⊢ proj b c : (if b then B1 else B2)
| typeForce v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : U A -> Gamma ⊢ v! : A
| typeCaseZ v A: Gamma ⊩ v : zero -> Gamma ⊢ caseZ v : A
| typeCaseS v c1 c2 A1 A2 C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2 ->
    A1, Gamma ⊢ c1 : C ->
    A2, Gamma ⊢ c2 : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseS v c1 c2 : C
| typeCaseP v c A B C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A * B ->
    B, A, Gamma  ⊢ c : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseP v c : C
where "Gamma ⊢ c : A" := (@computation_typing _ Gamma c A).

Scheme value_typing_ind_2 := Minimality for value_typing Sort Prop
  with computation_typing_ind_2  := Minimality for computation_typing Sort Prop.

Scheme value_typing_ind_3 := Minimality for value_typing Sort Type
  with computation_typing_ind_3  := Minimality for computation_typing Sort Type.

Combined Scheme mutind_value_computation_typing from
         value_typing_ind_2, computation_typing_ind_2.

Scheme value_typing_ind_4 := Induction for value_typing Sort Prop
    with computation_typing_ind_4  := Induction for computation_typing Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutindt_value_computation_typing from
          value_typing_ind_4, computation_typing_ind_4.

Section Confluence.

Variable X: Type.

Implicit Types (x y z : X) (R S : X -> X -> Prop).

Definition joinable R x y := exists2 z, R x z & R y z.

Definition diamond R := forall x y z, R x y -> R x z -> joinable R y z.

Definition confluent R := diamond (star R).

Definition semi_confluent R :=
    forall x y z, R x y -> star R x z -> joinable (star R) y z.

End Confluence.

Inductive starL {X: Type} (R: X -> X -> Prop) (x : X):  X -> Prop :=
| starReflL : starL R x x
| starStepL  y y':  starL R x y -> R y y' -> starL R x y'.
=== StrongReduction.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.ProgramContexts CBPV.Semantics.

Import CommaNotation.

Reserved Notation "C1 ⇒ C2" (at level 60).

Reserved Notation "V1 ⇒ᵥ V2" (at level 60).

Inductive strong_step {n: nat} : comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| strong_reduce  m (c1 c2: comp m) (K: cctx false n m):
    c1 ≽ c2 -> fillc K c1 ⇒ fillc K c2
where "C1 ⇒ C2" := (strong_step C1 C2).

Inductive strong_step_value {n : nat} : value n -> value n -> Prop :=
| strong_reduce_value k (c1 c2 : comp k) (K : vctx false n k) :
    c1 ≽ c2 -> fillv K c1 ⇒ᵥ fillv K c2
where "V1 ⇒ᵥ V2" := (strong_step_value V1 V2).

Reserved Notation "C1 ↪ C2" (at level 60).

Reserved Notation "V1 ↪ᵥ V2" (at level 60).

Inductive sstep {n: nat} : comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| sstepForce (v v': value n): v ↪ᵥ v' -> v ! ↪ v' !
| sstepLambda (c c': comp (S n)): c ↪ c' -> lambda c ↪ lambda c'
| sstepAppL (c c': comp n) v: c ↪ c' -> c v ↪ c' v
| sstepAppR (c: comp n) (v v': value n): v ↪ᵥ v' -> c v ↪ c v'
| sstepTupleL (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 ↪ c1' -> tuple c1 c2 ↪ tuple c1' c2
| sstepTupleR c1 (c2 c2': comp n): c2 ↪ c2' -> tuple c1 c2 ↪ tuple c1 c2'
| sstepRet (v v': value n): v ↪ᵥ v' -> ret v ↪ ret v'
| sstepLetinL (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 ↪ c1' -> letin c1 c2 ↪ letin c1' c2
| sstepLetinR c1 (c2 c2': comp (S n)): c2 ↪ c2' -> letin c1 c2 ↪ letin c1 c2'
| sstepProj (c c': comp n) b: c ↪ c' -> proj b c ↪ proj b c'
| sstepCaseZ (v v': value n): v ↪ᵥ v' -> caseZ v ↪ caseZ v'
| sstepCaseSV (v v': value n) c1 c2: v ↪ᵥ v' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v' c1 c2
| sstepCaseSL (v: value n) c1 c1' c2: c1 ↪ c1' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v c1' c2
| sstepCaseSR (v: value n) c1 c2 c2': c2 ↪ c2' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v c1 c2'
| sstepCasePV (v v': value n) c: v ↪ᵥ v' -> caseP v c ↪ caseP v' c
| sstepCasePC (v: value n) c c': c ↪ c' -> caseP v c ↪ caseP v c'
| sstepPrimitive (c c': comp n) : c ≽ c' -> c ↪ c'
where "C1 ↪ C2" := (@sstep _ C1 C2)
with sstep_value {n: nat} : value n -> value n -> Prop :=
| sstepValuePairL (v1 v1' v2: value n) : v1 ↪ᵥ v1' -> pair v1 v2 ↪ᵥ pair v1' v2
| sstepValuePairR (v1 v2 v2': value n) : v2 ↪ᵥ v2' -> pair v1 v2 ↪ᵥ pair v1 v2'
| sstepValueInj b (v v': value n) : v ↪ᵥ v' -> inj b v ↪ᵥ inj b v'
| sstepValueThunk (c c': comp n) : c ↪ c' -> <{ c }> ↪ᵥ <{ c' }>
where "V1 ↪ᵥ V2" := (@sstep_value _ V1 V2).

Scheme sstep_value_ind_2 := Induction for sstep_value Sort Prop
  with sstep_ind_2  := Induction for sstep Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_sstep from sstep_ind_2, sstep_value_ind_2.

Notation "M ↪* N" := (star sstep M N) (at level 60).

Notation "M ↪ᵥ* N" := (star sstep_value M N) (at level 60).
=== ObservationalEquivalence.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.ProgramContexts.

Record CBPVv {n: nat} (Gamma: ctx n) (A: valtype) :=
  mkCBPVv { CBPVv_v :> value n; CBPVv_H :> Gamma ⊩ CBPVv_v : A }.

Record CBPVc {n: nat} (Gamma: ctx n) (B: comptype) :=
  mkCBPVc { CBPVc_c :> comp n; CBPVc_H :> Gamma ⊢ CBPVc_c : B }.

Definition value_obseq {n: nat} {A: valtype} {Gamma: ctx n} (H1 H2: CBPVv Gamma A) :=
  forall (G: groundtype) (C: cctx true 0 n),
    null [[Gamma]] ⊢ C : F G; A -> forall v, (fillc C H1 >* ret v) <-> (fillc C H2 >* ret v).

Notation "V1 ≈ V2" := (value_obseq V1 V2) (at level 50).

Definition comp_obseq {n: nat} {B: comptype} {Gamma: ctx n} (H1 H2: CBPVc Gamma B) :=
  forall (G: groundtype) (C: cctx false 0 n),
    null [[Gamma]] ⊢ C : F G; B -> forall v, (fillc C H1 >* ret v) <-> (fillc C H2 >* ret v).

Notation "C1 ≃ C2" := (comp_obseq C1 C2) (at level 50).
=== SyntacticTyping.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.Terms CBPV.Base CBPV.Semantics.

Import CommaNotation.

Reserved Notation "Gamma ⊢ c : A" (at level 80, c at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Gamma ⊩ v : A" (at level 80, v at level 99).

Definition ctx (n: nat) := fin n -> valtype.

Inductive value_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : value m -> valtype -> Type :=
| typeVar i : Gamma ⊩ var_value i : Gamma i
| typeUnit: Gamma ⊩ u : one
| typePair v1 v2 A1 A2:
    Gamma ⊩ v1 : A1 -> Gamma ⊩ v2 : A2 -> Gamma ⊩ pair v1 v2 : cross A1 A2
| typeSum A1 A2 (b: bool) v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : (if b then A1 else A2) -> Gamma ⊩ inj b v : Sigma A1 A2
| typeThunk c A:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A -> Gamma ⊩ thunk c : U A
where "Gamma ⊩ v : A" := (value_typing Gamma v A)


with computation_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : comp m -> comptype -> Type :=
| typeCone: Gamma ⊢ cu : cone
| typeLambda (c: comp (S m)) A B:
    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B -> (Gamma ⊢ lambda c : A → B)
| typeLetin c1 c2 A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : F A -> A .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B -> Gamma ⊢ $ <- c1; c2 : B
| typeRet v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ ret v : F A
| typeApp c v A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B -> Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ c v : B
| typeTuple c1 c2 B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : B1  -> Gamma ⊢ c2 : B2 -> Gamma ⊢ tuple c1 c2 : Pi B1 B2
| typeProj b c B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c : Pi B1 B2 -> Gamma ⊢ proj b c : (if b then B1 else B2)
| typeForce v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : U A -> Gamma ⊢ v! : A
| typeCaseZ v A: Gamma ⊩ v : zero -> Gamma ⊢ caseZ v : A
| typeCaseS v c1 c2 A1 A2 C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2 ->
    A1, Gamma ⊢ c1 : C ->
    A2, Gamma ⊢ c2 : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseS v c1 c2 : C
| typeCaseP v c A B C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A * B ->
    B, A, Gamma  ⊢ c : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseP v c : C
where "Gamma ⊢ c : A" := (@computation_typing _ Gamma c A).

Scheme value_typing_ind_2 := Minimality for value_typing Sort Prop
  with computation_typing_ind_2  := Minimality for computation_typing Sort Prop.

Scheme value_typing_ind_3 := Minimality for value_typing Sort Type
  with computation_typing_ind_3  := Minimality for computation_typing Sort Type.

Combined Scheme mutind_value_computation_typing from
         value_typing_ind_2, computation_typing_ind_2.

Scheme value_typing_ind_4 := Induction for value_typing Sort Prop
    with computation_typing_ind_4  := Induction for computation_typing Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutindt_value_computation_typing from
          value_typing_ind_4, computation_typing_ind_4.

=== ProgramContexts.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export SyntacticTyping.

Inductive vctx (t: bool) (m: nat): nat -> Type :=
  | vctxHole : (if t then True else False) -> vctx t m m
  | vctxPairL n: vctx t m n -> value m -> vctx t m n
  | vctxPairR n : value m -> vctx t m n -> vctx t m n
  | vctxInj n : bool -> vctx t m n -> vctx t m n
  | vctxThunk n : cctx t m n -> vctx t m n


with cctx (t: bool) (m: nat) : nat -> Type :=
  | cctxHole: (if t then False else True) -> cctx t m m
  | cctxForce n : vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLambda n: cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxAppL n:  cctx t m n -> value m -> cctx t m n
  | cctxAppR n:  comp m -> vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxTupleL n: cctx t m n -> comp m -> cctx t m n
  | cctxTupleR n: comp m -> cctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxRet n: vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLetinL n: cctx t m n -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLetinR n: comp m -> cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxProj n: bool -> cctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseZ n: vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSV n: vctx t m n -> comp (S m) -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSL n: value m -> cctx t (S m) n -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSR n: value m -> comp (S m) -> cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCasePV n: vctx t m n -> comp (S (S m)) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCasePC n: value m -> cctx t (S (S m)) n -> cctx t m n.

Scheme vctx_ind_2 := Induction for vctx Sort Prop
  with cctx_ind_2  := Induction for cctx Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_vctx_cctx from vctx_ind_2, cctx_ind_2.

Notation "'•__v'" := (vctxHole true _ I).

Notation "'•__c'" := (cctxHole false _ I).

Fixpoint fillv {m n: nat} {t: bool} (C: vctx t m n) : (if t then value n else comp n) -> value m :=
  match C in vctx _ _ n return (if t then value n else comp n) -> value m with
  | vctxHole _ _ H =>
    (match t return (if t then True else False) -> (if t then value m else comp m) -> value m with
    |  true => fun _ v' => v'
    | false => fun f _ => match f with end
    end) H
  | vctxPairL C v => fun v' => pair (fillv C v') v
  | vctxPairR v C => fun v' => pair v (fillv C v')
  | vctxInj b C => fun v' => inj b (fillv C v')
  | vctxThunk C => fun v' => <{ fillc C v' }>
  end
with fillc {m n: nat} {t: bool} (C: cctx t m n) : (if t then value n else comp n) -> comp m :=
  match C in cctx _ _ n return (if t then value n else comp n) -> comp m with
  | cctxHole _ _ H =>
    (match t return (if t then False else True) -> (if t then value m else comp m) -> comp m with
     | false => fun _ v' => v'
     | true => fun f _ => match f with end
     end) H
  | cctxForce C => fun v' => (fillv C v') !
  | cctxLambda C => fun v' => lambda (fillc C v')
  | cctxAppL C v => fun v' => (fillc C v') v
  | cctxAppR c C => fun v' => c (fillv C v')
  | cctxTupleL C c => fun v' => tuple (fillc C v') c
  | cctxTupleR c C => fun v' => tuple c (fillc C v')
  | cctxRet C => fun v' => ret (fillv C v')
  | cctxLetinL C c => fun v' => letin (fillc C v') c
  | cctxLetinR c C => fun v' => letin c (fillc C v')
  | cctxProj b C => fun v' => proj b (fillc C v')
  | cctxCaseZ C => fun v' => caseZ (fillv C v')
  | cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 => fun v' => caseS (fillv C v') c1 c2
  | cctxCaseSL v C c2 => fun v' => caseS v (fillc C v') c2
  | cctxCaseSR v c1 C => fun v' => caseS v c1 (fillc C v')
  | cctxCasePV C c => fun v' => caseP (fillv C v') c
  | cctxCasePC v C => fun v' => caseP v (fillc C v')
  end.

Reserved Notation "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T" (at level 53, C at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T" (at level 53,  C at level 99).

Definition valtypeif (t: bool) (A: valtype):
  (if t then True else False) -> if t then valtype else comptype :=
  match t with
  | true => fun _ => A
  | false => fun f => match f with end
  end.

Definition comptypeif (t: bool) (B: comptype):
  (if t then False else True) -> if t then valtype else comptype :=
  match t with
  | false => fun _ => B
  | true => fun f => match f with end
  end.

Inductive vctxTyping {m: nat} {t: bool} (Gamma: ctx m) :
  forall n, ctx n -> vctx t m n -> valtype -> (if t then valtype else comptype) -> Type :=
| vctxTypingHole A H:
    Gamma [[ Gamma ]] ⊩ vctxHole t m H : A; valtypeif t A H
| vctxTypingPairL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 v:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A1; A ->
    Gamma ⊩ v : A2  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxPairL C v : A1 * A2; A
| vctxTypingPairR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A1  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxPairR v C : A1 * A2; A
| vctxTypingInj n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 (b: bool):
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : (if b then A1 else A2); A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxInj b C : Sigma A1 A2; A
| vctxTypingThunk n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B A:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxThunk C : U B; A
where "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T " := (@vctxTyping _ _ Gamma _  Delta C A T)

with cctxTyping {m: nat} {t: bool} (Gamma: ctx m) :
  forall n, ctx n -> cctx t m n -> comptype -> (if t then valtype else comptype) -> Type :=
| cctxTypingHole A H:
    Gamma [[ Gamma ]] ⊢ cctxHole t m H : A; comptypeif t A H
| cctxTypingLambda n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A A' B:
    (A .: Gamma) [[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
      Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLambda C : A → B; A'
| cctxTypingForce n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) B A':
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊩ C : U B; A' ->
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxForce C : B; A'
| cctxTypingAppL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A A' B v:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : A → B; A' ->
    Gamma ⊩ v : A  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxAppL C v : B; A'
| cctxTypingAppR n (Delta: ctx n) c (C: vctx t m n) A A' B :
    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxAppR c C : B; A'
| cctxTypingTupleL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B1 B2 A c:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B1; A ->
    Gamma ⊢ c : B2  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxTupleL C c : Pi B1 B2; A
| cctxTypingTupleR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B1 B2 A c:
    Gamma ⊢ c : B1  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxTupleR c C : Pi B1 B2; A
| cctxTypingRet n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A':
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊩ C : A; A' ->
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxRet C : F A; A'
| cctxTypingLetinL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A A' B c:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : F A; A' ->
    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLetinL C c : B; A'
| cctxTypingLetinR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A A' B c:
    Gamma ⊢ c : F A  ->
    (A .: Gamma)[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLetinR c C : B; A'
| cctxTypingProj n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A B1 B2 (b: bool):
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : Pi B1 B2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxProj b C : (if b then B1 else B2); A
| cctxTypingCaseZ n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A':
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : zero; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseZ C : A; A'
| cctxTypingCaseSV n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A1 A2 A' B c1 c2:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : Sigma A1 A2; A' ->
    A1 .: Gamma ⊢ c1 : B  ->
    A2 .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 : B; A'
| cctxTypingCaseSL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A1 A2 A' B v c2:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2  ->
    (A1 .: Gamma)[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
    A2 .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSL v C c2 : B; A'
| cctxTypingCaseSR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A1 A2 A' B v c1:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2  ->
    A1 .: Gamma ⊢ c1 : B  ->
    (A2 .: Gamma)[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSR v c1 C : B; A'
| cctxTypingCasePV n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A1 A2 A' B c:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A1 * A2; A' ->
    (A2 .: (A1 .: Gamma)) ⊢ c : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCasePV C c : B; A'
| cctxTypingCasePC n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S (S m)) n) A1 A2 A' B v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A1 * A2  ->
    (A2 .: (A1 .: Gamma))[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCasePC v C : B; A'
where "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T " := (@cctxTyping _ _ Gamma _ Delta C B T).

Scheme vctx_typing_ind_2 := Minimality for vctxTyping Sort Prop
  with cctx_typing_ind_2  := Minimality for cctxTyping Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_vctx_cctx_typing from
         vctx_typing_ind_2, cctx_typing_ind_2.

Scheme vctx_typing_ind_3 := Induction for vctxTyping Sort Prop
  with cctx_typing_ind_3  := Induction for cctxTyping Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutindt_vctx_cctx_typing from
          vctx_typing_ind_3, cctx_typing_ind_3.

Fixpoint plugvctx {m n k: nat} {t1 t2: bool} (C: vctx t1 m n) :
  (if t1 then vctx t2 n k else cctx t2 n k) -> vctx t2 m k :=

  match C in vctx _ _ n return (if t1 then vctx t2 n k else cctx t2 n k) -> vctx t2 m k  with
  | vctxHole _ _ H =>
    match t1 return (if t1 then True else False) -> (if t1 then vctx t2 m k else cctx t2 m k)  -> vctx t2 m k with
    | true => fun _ v' => v'
    | false => fun f _ => match f with end
    end H
  | vctxPairL C v => fun C' => vctxPairL (plugvctx C C')  v
  | vctxPairR v C => fun C' => vctxPairR v (plugvctx C C')
  | vctxInj b C => fun C' => vctxInj b (plugvctx C C')
  | vctxThunk C => fun C' => vctxThunk (plugcctx C C')
  end

with plugcctx {m n k: nat} {t1 t2: bool} (C: cctx t1 m n) :
(if t1 then vctx t2 n k else cctx t2 n k) -> cctx t2 m k :=
  match C in cctx _ _ n return (if t1 then vctx t2 n k else cctx t2 n k)  -> cctx t2 m k with
  | cctxHole _ _ H =>
    match t1 return (if t1 then False else True) -> (if t1 then vctx t2 m k else cctx t2 m k)  -> cctx t2 m k  with
    | false => fun _ C' => C'
    | true => fun f _ => match f with end
    end H
  | cctxForce C => fun C' => cctxForce (plugvctx C C')
  | cctxLambda C => fun C' => cctxLambda (plugcctx C C')
  | cctxAppL C v => fun C' => cctxAppL (plugcctx C C') v
  | cctxAppR c C => fun C' => cctxAppR c (plugvctx C C')
  | cctxTupleL C c => fun C' => cctxTupleL (plugcctx C C') c
  | cctxTupleR c C => fun C' => cctxTupleR c (plugcctx C C')
  | cctxRet C => fun C' => cctxRet (plugvctx C C')
  | cctxLetinL C c => fun C' => cctxLetinL (plugcctx C C') c
  | cctxLetinR c C => fun C' => cctxLetinR c (plugcctx C C')
  | cctxProj b C => fun C' => cctxProj b (plugcctx C C')
  | cctxCaseZ C => fun C' => cctxCaseZ (plugvctx C C')
  | cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 => fun C' => cctxCaseSV (plugvctx C C') c1 c2
  | cctxCaseSL v C c2 => fun C' => cctxCaseSL v (plugcctx C C') c2
  | cctxCaseSR v c1 C => fun C' => cctxCaseSR v c1 (plugcctx C C')
  | cctxCasePV C c => fun C' => cctxCasePV (plugvctx C C') c
  | cctxCasePC v C => fun C' => cctxCasePC v (plugcctx C C')
  end.
=== fintype.v ===
Require Export axioms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Type :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y)  :=

Lemma star_step_app {n} : forall (c c': comp n) v, star step c c' -> star step (c v) (c' v).

  - apply starRefl.
  - eapply starStep with (x' := c' v); [apply stepApp|exact IH].

  - eapply starStep with (x' := proj b c'); [apply stepProj|exact IH].

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import CBPV.ObservationalEquivalence CBPV.StrongReduction CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems.
Import CommaNotation.

(* Closed logical relation using bigstep *)

Fixpoint VRel0 (A: valtype) (V W: value 0) {struct A} : Prop :=
  match A with
  | zero => False
  | one => V = W
  | U B => exists c c', V = thunk c /\ W = thunk c' /\ CRel0 B c c'
  | Sigma A1 A2 => exists b v v', V = inj b v /\ W = inj b v' /\
       (if b then VRel0 A1 v v' else VRel0 A2 v v')
  | cross A1 A2 => exists v1 v2 w1 w2, V = pair v1 v2 /\ W = pair w1 w2 /\
       VRel0 A1 v1 w1 /\ VRel0 A2 v2 w2
  end
with CRel0 (B: comptype) (c c': comp 0) {struct B} : Prop :=
  match B with
  | cone => True
  | F A => (forall v, c ▷ ret v -> exists v', c' ▷ ret v' /\ VRel0 A v v')
        /\ (forall v', c' ▷ ret v' -> exists v, c ▷ ret v /\ VRel0 A v v')
  | Pi B1 B2 => CRel0 B1 (proj false c) (proj false c') /\
                CRel0 B2 (proj true c) (proj true c')
  | arrow A B => forall v v', VRel0 A v v' -> CRel0 B (c v) (c' v')
  end.

(* Symmetry *)
Fixpoint VRel0_sym (A: valtype) (V W: value 0) {struct A} : VRel0 A V W -> VRel0 A W V
with CRel0_sym (B: comptype) (c c': comp 0) {struct B} : CRel0 B c c' -> CRel0 B c' c.
Proof.
  - destruct A; simpl.
    + exact (fun H => H).
    + exact (fun H => eq_sym H).
    + intros [c [c' [E [E' H]]]]. exists c', c. split; [exact E'|split; [exact E|]].
      apply CRel0_sym. exact H.
    + intros [b [v [v' [E [E' H]]]]]. exists b, v', v. split; [exact E'|split; [exact E|]].
      destruct b; [apply VRel0_sym|apply VRel0_sym]; exact H.
    + intros [v1 [v2 [w1 [w2 [E [E' [H1 H2]]]]]]].
      exists w1, w2, v1, v2. split; [exact E'|split; [exact E|split]].
      * apply VRel0_sym. exact H1.
      * apply VRel0_sym. exact H2.
  - destruct B; simpl.
    + intros _. exact I.
    + intros [H1 H2]. split.
      * intros v H. apply H2. exact H.
      * intros v H. apply H1. exact H.
    + intros [H1 H2]. split.
      * apply CRel0_sym. exact H1.
      * apply CRel0_sym. exact H2.
    + intros H v v' HV. apply CRel0_sym. apply H. exact HV.
Qed.

(* Transitivity *)
Fixpoint VRel0_trans (A: valtype) (V W X: value 0) {struct A} :
  VRel0 A V W -> VRel0 A W X -> VRel0 A V X
with CRel0_trans (B: comptype) (c c' c'': comp 0) {struct B} :
  CRel0 B c c' -> CRel0 B c' c'' -> CRel0 B c c''.
Proof.
  - destruct A; simpl.
    + intros H. exact H.
    + intros H1 H2. transitivity W; assumption.
    + intros [c1 [c2 [E1 [E2 H]]]] [c3 [c4 [E3 [E4 H2]]]].
      subst. inversion E2; subst. exists c1, c4. split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|]].
      eapply CRel0_trans; eauto.
    + intros [b [v1 [v2 [E1 [E2 H]]]]] [b' [w1 [w2 [E3 [E4 H2]]]]].
      subst. inversion E2; subst. inversion E4; subst.
      exists b, v1, w2. split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|]].
      destruct b; [eapply VRel0_trans|eapply VRel0_trans]; eauto.
    + intros [v1 [v2 [w1 [w2 [E1 [E2 [H1 H2]]]]]]] [x1 [x2 [y1 [y2 [E3 [E4 [H3 H4]]]]]]].
      subst. inversion E2; subst. inversion E4; subst.
      exists v1, v2, y1, y2. split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|split]].
      * eapply VRel0_trans; eauto.
      * eapply VRel0_trans; eauto.
  - destruct B; simpl.
    + intros _ _. exact I.
    + intros [H1 H2] [H3 H4]. split.
      * intros v Hv. apply H1 in Hv as [v' [Hv' HV]]. apply H3 in Hv' as [v'' [Hv'' HV']].
        exists v''. split; [exact Hv''|]. eapply VRel0_trans; eauto.
      * intros v Hv. apply H4 in Hv as [v' [Hv' HV]]. apply H2 in Hv' as [v'' [Hv'' HV']].
        exists v''. split; [exact Hv''|]. eapply VRel0_trans; eauto.
    + intros [H1 H2] [H3 H4]. split.
      * eapply CRel0_trans; eauto.
      * eapply CRel0_trans; eauto.
    + intros H1 H2 v v' HV. eapply CRel0_trans; [apply H1|apply H2]; exact HV.
Qed.

(* BSim *)
Definition BSim (c c': comp 0) : Prop := forall r, c ▷ r <-> c' ▷ r.

Lemma BSim_refl c : BSim c c.
Proof. intros r. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma BSim_sym c c' : BSim c c' -> BSim c' c.
Proof. intros H r. symmetry. apply H. Qed.

Lemma BSim_trans c c' c'' : BSim c c' -> BSim c' c'' -> BSim c c''.
Proof. intros H1 H2 r. transitivity (c' ▷ r); [apply H1|apply H2]. Qed.

Lemma BSim_app c c' v : BSim c c' -> BSim (c v) (c' v).
Proof.
  intros H r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr as [c0 c2 c1 v0 Hfun Hbody]; subst.
    apply bigstepApp with (c' := c1); [apply H|exact Hbody].
  - inversion Hr as [c0 c2 c1 v0 Hfun Hbody]; subst.
    apply bigstepApp with (c' := c1); [apply H|exact Hbody].
Qed.

Lemma BSim_proj c c' b : BSim c c' -> BSim (proj b c) (proj b c').
Proof.
  intros H r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr as [c0 c1 c2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
    eapply bigstepProj; [apply H|exact H2].
  - inversion Hr as [c0 c1 c2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
    eapply bigstepProj; [apply H|exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma BSim_force_thunk (d: comp 0) : BSim (force (thunk d)) d.
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr. assumption.
  - eapply bigstepForce. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma BSim_proj_tuple b (c1 c2: comp 0) :
  BSim (proj b (tuple c1 c2)) (if b then c1 else c2).
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr as [c0 d1 d2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
    inversion H1; subst. exact H2.
  - eapply bigstepProj.
    + apply bigstepTuple.
    + exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma BSim_app_lambda (c0: comp 1) (v: value 0) :
  BSim (app (lambda c0) v) (c0[v..]).
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr as [c c'' c' v0 Hfun Hbody]; subst.
    inversion Hfun; subst. exact Hbody.
  - eapply bigstepApp.
    + apply bigstepLambda.
    + exact Hr.
Qed.

(* One-sided BSim transfer *)
Fixpoint CRel0_BSim_left (B: comptype) (X Y Z: comp 0) {struct B} :
  BSim X Y -> CRel0 B Y Z -> CRel0 B X Z
with CRel0_BSim_right (B: comptype) (X Y Z: comp 0) {struct B} :
  CRel0 B X Y -> BSim Y Z -> CRel0 B X Z.
Proof.
  - destruct B; simpl.
    + intros _ _. exact I.
    + intros HB HR. split.
      * intros v Hv. apply HB in Hv. apply HR in Hv. exact Hv.
      * intros v Hv. apply HR in Hv as [w [Hw HV]]. exists w. split; [|exact HV].
        apply HB. exact Hw.
    + intros HB [H1 H2]. split.
      * eapply CRel0_BSim_left; [apply BSim_proj|exact H1].
      * eapply CRel0_BSim_left; [apply BSim_proj|exact H2].
    + intros HB HR v v' HV.
      eapply CRel0_BSim_left; [apply BSim_app|apply HR]; exact HV.
  - destruct B; simpl.
    + intros _ _. exact I.
    + intros HR HB. split.
      * intros v Hv. apply HR in Hv as [w [Hw HV]]. exists w. split; [|exact HV].
        apply HB. exact Hw.
      * intros v Hv. apply HB in Hv. apply HR in Hv. exact Hv.
    + intros [H1 H2] HB. split.
      * eapply CRel0_BSim_right; [exact H1|apply BSim_proj].
      * eapply CRel0_BSim_right; [exact H2|apply BSim_proj].
    + intros HR HB v v' HV.
      eapply CRel0_BSim_right; [apply HR|apply BSim_app]; exact HV.
Qed.
EOF

Require Import CBPV.ObservationalEquivalence CBPV.StrongReduction CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems.
Import CommaNotation.

(* Strong (structural) value relation *)
Fixpoint SVRel (A: valtype) (V W: value 0) {struct A} : Prop :=
  match A with
  | zero => V = W
  | one => V = W
  | U B => exists c c', V = thunk c /\ W = thunk c' /\ CRel0 B c c'
  | Sigma A1 A2 => exists b v v', V = inj b v /\ W = inj b v' /\
       (if b then SVRel A1 v v' else SVRel A2 v v')
  | cross A1 A2 => exists v1 v2 w1 w2, V = pair v1 v2 /\ W = pair w1 w2 /\
       SVRel A1 v1 w1 /\ SVRel A2 v2 w2
  end
with VRel0 (A: valtype) (V W: value 0) {struct A} : Prop :=
  V = W \/ SVRel A V W
with CRel0 (B: comptype) (c c': comp 0) {struct B} : Prop :=
  match B with
  | cone => True
  | F A => (forall v, c ▷ ret v -> exists v', c' ▷ ret v' /\ SVRel A v v')

  | Pi B1 B2 => CRel0 B1 (proj false c) (proj false c') /\

  | arrow A B => forall v v', VRel0 A v v' -> CRel0 B (c v)(c' v')
  end.

Lemma SVRel_to_VRel0 A V W : SVRel A V W -> VRel0 A V W.
Proof. intros H. right. exact H. Qed.

Definition BSim (c c': comp 0) : Prop := forall r, c ▷ r <-> c' ▷ r.

Lemma BSim_refl c : BSim c c.
Proof. intros r. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma BSim_sym c c' : BSim c c' -> BSim c' c.
Proof. intros H r. symmetry. apply H. Qed.

Lemma BSim_trans c c' c'' : BSim c c' -> BSim c' c'' -> BSim c c''.
Proof. intros H1 H2 r. transitivity (c' ▷ r); [apply H1|apply H2]. Qed.

Lemma BSim_app c c' v : BSim c c' -> BSim (c v) (c' v).
Proof.
  intros H r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr as [c0 c2 c1 v0 Hfun Hbody]; subst.
    eapply bigstepApp; [apply H|exact Hbody].
  - inversion Hr as [c0 c2 c1 v0 Hfun Hbody]; subst.
    eapply bigstepApp; [apply H|exact Hbody].
Qed.

Lemma BSim_proj c c' b : BSim c c' -> BSim (proj b c) (proj b c').
Proof.
  intros H r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr as [c0 c1 c2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
    eapply bigstepProj; [apply H|exact H2].
  - inversion Hr as [c0 c1 c2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
    eapply bigstepProj; [apply H|exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma BSim_force_thunk (d: comp 0) : BSim (force (thunk d)) d.
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr. assumption.
  - eapply bigstepForce. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma BSim_proj_tuple b (c1 c2: comp 0) :
  BSim (proj b (tuple c1 c2)) (if b then c1 else c2).
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr as [c0 d1 d2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
    inversion H1; subst. exact H2.
  - eapply bigstepProj.

    + exact Hr.
Qed.

(* Evaluation stacks of applications/projections *)
Inductive ctxstack : comptype -> comptype -> Type :=
| cs_hole : forall B, ctxstack B B
| cs_proj : forall B B1 B2 b, ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2) ->
      ctxstack B (if b then B1 else B2)
| cs_app : forall B A C, ctxstack B (arrow A C) -> value 0 -> ctxstack B C.

Fixpoint apply_stack {B C} (K: ctxstack B C) (c: comp 0) : comp 0 :=
  match K in ctxstack _ C return comp 0 with
  | cs_hole _ => c
  | cs_proj _ _ _ b K0 => proj b (apply_stack K0 c)
  | cs_app _ _ _ K0 v => apply_stack K0 c v
  end.

Inductive stack_pair : forall B C, ctxstack B C -> ctxstack B C -> Prop :=
| sp_hole B : stack_pair (cs_hole B) (cs_hole B)
| sp_proj B B1 B2 b K K' : stack_pair K K' ->
      stack_pair (cs_proj b K) (cs_proj b K')
| sp_app B A C K K' v v' : stack_pair K K' -> VRel0 A v v' ->
      stack_pair (cs_app K v) (cs_app K' v').

Lemma stack_compat : forall B C (K K': ctxstack B C),
  stack_pair K K' -> forall Z Z', CRel0 B Z Z' ->
  CRel0 C (apply_stack K Z) (apply_stack K' Z').
Proof.
  intros B C K K' SP. induction SP as [B|B B1 B2 b K K' SP IH|B A C K K' v v' SP HV IH].
  - intros Z Z' H. simpl. exact H.
  - intros Z Z' H. simpl. destruct b; simpl in *.
    + eapply IH. apply H.
    + eapply IH. apply H.
  - intros Z Z' H. simpl. eapply IH.
    eapply (proj1 (conj (H) (H))). (* placeholder *)
Abort.
EOF

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import CBPV.ObservationalEquivalence CBPV.StrongReduction CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems.
3	Import CommaNotation.
4	
5	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
6	(* Basic helper facts about the lifting operations                     *)
7	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
8	
9	Lemma up_value_value_congr {m n} {sigma tau : fin m -> value n}
10	  (H : forall i, sigma i = tau i) :
11	  forall i, up_value_value sigma i = up_value_value tau i.
12	Proof.
13	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
14	  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp].
15	    change (ren_value shift (sigma x) = ren_value shift (tau x)).
16	    apply f_equal, H.
17	  - reflexivity.
18	Qed.
19	
20	Lemma up_value_value_ids {m} :
21	  forall i : fin (S m),
22	    up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value m) i = var_value i.
23	Proof.
24	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
25	  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp]. reflexivity.
26	  - reflexivity.
27	Qed.
28	
29	Lemma up_value_value_ids2 {m} :
30	  forall i : fin (S (S m)),
31	    up_value_value (up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value m)) i
32	    = var_value i.
33	Proof.
34	  intros i.
35	  transitivity (up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value (S m)) i).
36	  - apply up_value_value_congr. intros j. apply up_value_value_ids.
37	  - apply up_value_value_ids.
38	Qed.
39	
40	Lemma up_ren_congr {m n} {xi xi' : fin m -> fin n}
41	  (H : forall i, xi i = xi' i) :
42	  forall i, up_ren xi i = up_ren xi' i.
43	Proof.
44	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
45	  - cbn [up_ren scons funcomp shift bound].
46	    change (Some (xi x) = Some (xi' x)).
47	    apply f_equal, H.
48	  - reflexivity.
49	Qed.
50	
51	Lemma up_ren_comp {m n k} (xi1 : fin m -> fin n) (xi2 : fin n -> fin k) :
52	  forall i : fin (S m),
53	    up_ren (fun i => xi2 (xi1 i)) i = up_ren xi2 (up_ren xi1 i).
54	Proof.
55	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
56	  - cbn [up_ren scons funcomp shift bound]. reflexivity.
57	  - reflexivity.
58	Qed.
59	
60	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
61	(* Congruence for renaming                                            *)
62	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
63	
64	Fixpoint ren_value_congr {m n} (V : value m) {xi xi' : fin m -> fin n}
65	  (H : forall i, xi i = xi' i) {struct V} :
66	  ren_value xi V = ren_value xi' V
67	with ren_comp_congr {m n} (c : comp m) {xi xi' : fin m -> fin n}
68	  (H : forall i, xi i = xi' i) {struct c} :
69	  ren_comp xi c = ren_comp xi' c.
70	Proof.
71	  - destruct V; simpl.
72	    + apply f_equal, H.
73	    + reflexivity.
74	    + apply f_equal2; apply ren_value_congr; exact H.
75	    + apply f_equal2; [ reflexivity | apply ren_value_congr; exact H ].
76	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_comp_congr. exact H.
77	  - destruct c; simpl.
78	    + reflexivity.
79	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_value_congr. exact H.
80	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_comp_congr. apply up_ren_congr. exact H.
81	    + apply f_equal2; [ apply ren_comp_congr; exact H | apply ren_value_congr; exact H ].
82	    + apply f_equal2; apply ren_comp_congr; exact H.
83	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_value_congr. exact H.
84	    + apply f_equal2; [ apply ren_comp_congr; exact H
85	                       | apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_congr; exact H ].
86	    + apply f_equal2; [ reflexivity | apply ren_comp_congr; exact H ].
87	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_value_congr. exact H.
88	    + apply f_equal2; [ apply ren_value_congr; exact H
89	                       | apply f_equal2; apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_congr; exact H ].
90	    + apply f_equal2; [ apply ren_value_congr; exact H
91	                       | apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_congr; apply up_ren_congr; exact H ].
92	Defined.

(* caseS through a stack *)
Lemma caseS_decomp : forall (B C: comptype) (K: ctxstack B C)
  (V: value 0) (c1 c2: comp 1) r,
  apply_stack K (caseS V c1 c2) ▷ r ->
  exists b u, V = inj b u /\
    apply_stack K ((if b then c1 else c2)[u..]) ▷ r.
Proof.
  intros B C K. induction K as
    [B|B B1 B2 K0 IHK|B B1 B2 K0 IHK|B A C K0 IHK v];
    intros V c1 c2 r H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst. eauto.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst.
    match goal with
    | H0 : apply_stack K0 (caseS V c1 c2) ▷ tuple ?a ?b |- _ =>
      destruct (IHK V c1 c2 (tuple a b) H0) as (bb & u & HV & Hy);
      exists bb, u; split; [exact HV|];
      simpl; eapply bigstepProj; [exact Hy|eassumption]
    end.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst.
    match goal with
    | H0 : apply_stack K0 (caseS V c1 c2) ▷ tuple ?a ?b |- _ =>
      destruct (IHK V c1 c2 (tuple a b) H0) as (bb & u & HV & Hy);
      exists bb, u; split; [exact HV|];
      simpl; eapply bigstepProj; [exact Hy|eassumption]
    end.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst.
    match goal with
    | H0 : apply_stack K0 (caseS V c1 c2) ▷ lambda ?c |- _ =>
      destruct (IHK V c1 c2 (lambda c) H0) as (bb & u & HV & Hy);
      exists bb, u; split; [exact HV|];
      simpl; eapply bigstepApp; [exact Hy|eassumption]
    end.
Qed.
Arguments caseS_decomp {B C} K V c1 c2 r _.

Lemma caseS_decomp_rev : forall (B C: comptype) (K: ctxstack B C)
  (V: value 0) (c1 c2: comp 1) b u r,
  V = inj b u ->
  apply_stack K ((if b then c1 else c2)[u..]) ▷ r ->
  apply_stack K (caseS V c1 c2) ▷ r.
Proof.
  intros B C K. induction K as
    [B|B B1 B2 K0 IHK|B B1 B2 K0 IHK|B A C K0 IHK v];
    intros V c1 c2 bb u r HV H.
  - simpl in *. subst. eapply bigstepCaseS. exact H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst.
    match goal with
    | H0 : apply_stack K0 ((if bb then c1 else c2)[u..]) ▷ tuple ?a ?b |- _ =>
      simpl; eapply bigstepProj;
      [apply IHK with (b:=bb)(u:=u); [exact HV|exact H0]|eassumption]
    end.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst.
    match goal with
    | H0 : apply_stack K0 ((if bb then c1 else c2)[u..]) ▷ tuple ?a ?b |- _ =>
      simpl; eapply bigstepProj;
      [apply IHK with (b:=bb)(u:=u); [exact HV|exact H0]|eassumption]
    end.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst.
    match goal with
    | H0 : apply_stack K0 ((if bb then c1 else c2)[u..]) ▷ lambda ?c |- _ =>
      simpl; eapply bigstepApp;
      [apply IHK with (b:=bb)(u:=u); [exact HV|exact H0]|eassumption]
    end.
Qed.
Arguments caseS_decomp_rev {B C} K V c1 c2 b u r _ _.

Lemma bind_caseS_stack : forall (C Bres: comptype) (K K': ctxstack Bres C),
  stack_pair K K' ->
  forall A1 A2 (V V': value 0) (c1 c1' c2 c2': comp 1),
  SVRel (Sigma A1 A2) V V' ->
  (forall u u', SVRel A1 u u' -> CRel0 Bres (c1[u..]) (c1'[u'..])) ->
  (forall u u', SVRel A2 u u' -> CRel0 Bres (c2[u..]) (c2'[u'..])) ->
  CRel0 C (apply_stack K (caseS V c1 c2))
           (apply_stack K' (caseS V' c1' c2')).
Proof.
  induction C as [|A0|C1 IHC1 C2 IHC2|A0 C1 IHC1];
    intros Bres K K' SP A1 A2 V V' c1 c1' c2 c2' HV H1 H2.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - (* C = F A0 *)
    destruct HV as (b & u & u' & Ev & Ev' & Hvu).
    split.
    + intros v Hv.
      destruct (caseS_decomp K V c1 c2 (ret v) Hv) as (b0 & w & HV0 & Hkv).
      injection HV0 as Hb Hw. subst b0. subst u.
      destruct (stack_compat SP ((if b then c1 else c2)[w..])
                   ((if b then c1' else c2')[u'..]) _) as (Hcom & _).
      * destruct b; simpl in *.
        -- apply H1. exact Hvu.
        -- apply H2. exact Hvu.
      * destruct (Hcom v Hkv) as (v' & Hv' & Hsv).
        exists v'. split; [|exact Hsv].
        eapply caseS_decomp_rev; [exact Ev'|exact Hv'].
    + intros v' Hv'.
      destruct (caseS_decomp K' V' c1' c2' (ret v') Hv') as (b0 & w' & HV0 & Hkv').
      injection HV0 as Hb Hw. subst b0. subst u'.
      destruct (stack_compat SP ((if b then c1 else c2)[u..])
                   ((if b then c1' else c2')[w'..]) _) as (_ & Hcom).
      * destruct b; simpl in *.
        -- apply H1. exact Hvu.
        -- apply H2. exact Hvu.
      * destruct (Hcom v' Hkv') as (v & Hv & Hsv).
        exists v. split; [|exact Hsv].
        eapply caseS_decomp_rev; [exact Ev|exact Hv].
  - (* C = Pi C1 C2 *)
    split.
    + eapply (IHC2 Bres (cs_projL K) (cs_projL K')).
      * apply sp_projL. exact SP.
      * exact HV. exact H1. exact H2.
    + eapply (IHC1 Bres (cs_projR K) (cs_projR K')).
      * apply sp_projR. exact SP.
      * exact HV. exact H1. exact H2.
  - (* C = arrow A0 C1 *)
    intros v v' HVv.
    eapply (IHC1 Bres (cs_app K v) (cs_app K' v')).
    + apply sp_app with (v:=v)(v':=v').
      * exact SP.
      * exact HVv.
    + exact HV. exact H1. exact H2.
Qed.

Inductive ctxstack : comptype -> comptype -> Type :=
| cs_hole : forall B, ctxstack B B
| cs_projL : forall B B1 B2, ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2) -> ctxstack B B2
| cs_projR : forall B B1 B2, ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2) -> ctxstack B B1
| cs_app : forall B A C, ctxstack B (arrow A C) -> value 0 -> ctxstack B C.

Fixpoint apply_stack {B C} (K: ctxstack B C) (c: comp 0) : comp 0 :=
  match K in ctxstack _ C return comp 0 with
  | cs_hole _ => c
  | cs_projL K0 => proj false (apply_stack K0 c)
  | cs_projR K0 => proj true (apply_stack K0 c)
  | cs_app K0 v => apply_stack K0 c v
  end.

Inductive stack_pair : forall B C, ctxstack B C -> ctxstack B C -> Prop :=
| sp_hole B : stack_pair (cs_hole B) (cs_hole B)
| sp_projL : forall B B1 B2 (K K' : ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2)),

| sp_projR : forall B B1 B2 (K K' : ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2)),
      stack_pair K K' -> stack_pair (cs_projR K) (cs_projR K')
| sp_app : forall B A C (K K' : ctxstack B (arrow A C)) v v',

Lemma caseP_decomp : forall (B C: comptype) (K: ctxstack B C)
  (V: value 0) (c: comp 2) r,
  apply_stack K (caseP V c) ▷ r ->
  exists v1 v2, V = pair v1 v2 /\\ apply_stack K (c[v2,v1..]) ▷ r.

    intros V c r H.
  - simpl in H. apply bigstep_caseP_inv in H. exact H.
  - simpl in H. apply bigstep_proj_inv in H as (a & b & Hp & Hr).
    destruct (IHK V c (tuple a b) Hp) as (v1 & v2 & HV & Hy).

Qed.

  SVRel (cross A1 A2) V V' ->

  forall r, ~ proj b c ▷ r.
Proof.

Lemma no_bigstep_app (c: comp 0) v : (forall r, ~ c ▷ r) ->
  forall r, ~ c v ▷ r.

  exact (H (lambda c0) Hp).

  - intros Hc Hc'. split.
    + intros v Hv. exfalso. exact (Hc (ret v) Hv).
    + intros v Hv. exfalso. exact (Hc' (ret v) Hv).

    + apply CRel0_no_bigstep.
      * apply no_bigstep_proj. exact Hc.
      * apply no_bigstep_proj. exact Hc'.
  - intros Hc Hc' v v' HV.
    apply CRel0_no_bigstep.
    + apply no_bigstep_app. exact Hc.
    + apply no_bigstep_app. exact Hc'.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_value_subst {m n k} (V : value m) (sigma : fin m -> value n)
  (tau : fin n -> value k) {struct V} :
  subst_value tau (subst_value sigma V) = subst_value (fun i => subst_value tau (sigma i)) V
with subst_comp_subst {m n k} (c : comp m) (sigma : fin m -> value n)
  (tau : fin n -> value k) {struct c} :
  subst_comp tau (subst_comp sigma c) = subst_comp (fun i => subst_value tau (sigma i)) c.
Proof.
  - destruct V; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + apply f_equal2; apply subst_value_subst.
    + apply f_equal2; [ reflexivity | apply subst_value_subst ].
    + apply f_equal. apply subst_comp_subst.
  - destruct c; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + apply f_equal. apply subst_value_subst.
    + apply f_equal.
      rewrite subst_comp_subst.
      apply subst_comp_congr.
      apply up_value_value_subst.
    + apply f_equal2; [ apply subst_comp_subst | apply subst_value_subst ].
    + apply f_equal2; apply subst_comp_subst.
    + apply f_equal. apply subst_value_subst.
    + apply f_equal2;

    + apply f_equal2; [ reflexivity | apply subst_comp_subst ].
    + apply f_equal. apply subst_value_subst.

Lemma up_value_value_app {m n} (sigma : fin m -> value n) (v : value n) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)),
    subst_value (scons v (@ids value VarInstance_value n)) (up_value_value sigma i)
    = scons v sigma i.
Proof.
  intros i. destruct i as [j|].
  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp].
    change (subst_value (scons v (@ids value VarInstance_value n))
              (ren_value shift (sigma j)) = sigma j).
    rewrite (ren_value_subst shift (sigma j)
               (scons v (@ids value VarInstance_value n))).
    transitivity (subst_value (@ids value VarInstance_value n) (sigma j)).
    + apply subst_value_congr. intros l. reflexivity.
    + apply subst_value_id.
  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp]. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma up_up_value_value_caseP {m n} (sigma : fin m -> value n) (v1 v2 : value n) :
  forall (i : fin (S (S m))),
    subst_value (scons v2 (scons v1 (@ids value VarInstance_value n)))
      (up_value_value (up_value_value sigma) i)
    = scons v2 (scons v1 sigma) i.
Proof.
  intros i. destruct i as [j|].
  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp].
    change (subst_value (scons v2 (scons v1 (@ids value VarInstance_value n)))
              (ren_value shift (up_value_value sigma j)) = scons v1 sigma j).
    rewrite (ren_value_subst shift (up_value_value sigma j)
               (scons v2 (scons v1 (@ids value VarInstance_value n)))).
    transitivity (subst_value (scons v1 (@ids value VarInstance_value n))
                    (up_value_value sigma j)).
    + apply subst_value_congr. intros l. reflexivity.
    + apply up_value_value_app.
  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp]. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_comp_up_app {m n} (c : comp (S m)) (sigma : fin m -> value n)
  (v : value n) :
  subst_comp (scons v (@ids value VarInstance_value n))
    (subst_comp (up_value_value sigma) c)
  = subst_comp (scons v sigma) c.
Proof.
  rewrite subst_comp_subst.
  apply subst_comp_congr.
  apply up_value_value_app.
Qed.

Lemma subst_comp_up_up_caseP {m n} (c : comp (S (S m))) (sigma : fin m -> value n)
  (v1 v2 : value n) :
  subst_comp (scons v2 (scons v1 (@ids value VarInstance_value n)))
    (subst_comp (up_value_value (up_value_value sigma)) c)
  = subst_comp (scons v2 (scons v1 sigma)) c.
Proof.
  rewrite subst_comp_subst.
  apply subst_comp_congr.
  apply up_up_value_value_caseP.
Qed.

Lemma subst_value_up_app {m n} (V : value (S m)) (sigma : fin m -> value n)
  (v : value n) :
  subst_value (scons v (@ids value VarInstance_value n))
    (subst_value (up_value_value sigma) V)
  = subst_value (scons v sigma) V.
Proof.
  rewrite subst_value_subst.
  apply subst_value_congr.
  apply up_value_value_app.

Lemma up_value_value_app {m n} (sigma : fin m -> value n) (v : value n) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)),

    transitivity (subst_value (@ids value VarInstance_value n) (sigma j)).

    + apply subst_value_id.

    = scons v2 (scons v1 sigma) i.
Proof.
  intros i. destruct i as [j|].
  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp].
    change (subst_value (scons v2 (scons v1 (@ids value VarInstance_value n)))

    + apply up_value_value_app.

  (v : value n) :

    (subst_comp (up_value_value sigma) c)
  = subst_comp (scons v sigma) c.
Proof.
  rewrite subst_comp_subst.
  apply subst_comp_congr.
  apply up_value_value_app.
Qed.

Lemma subst_comp_up_up_caseP {m n} (c : comp (S (S m))) (sigma : fin m -> value n)
  (v1 v2 : value n) :

    (subst_comp (up_value_value (up_value_value sigma)) c)

Proof.

  apply subst_comp_congr.
  apply up_up_value_value_caseP.

  (v : value n) :
  subst_value (scons v (@ids value VarInstance_value n))
    (subst_value (up_value_value sigma) V)
  = subst_value (scons v sigma) V.
Proof.
  rewrite subst_value_subst.
  apply subst_value_congr.
  apply up_value_value_app.

Definition EnvRel {n} (Γ: ctx n) (σ σ': fin n -> value 0) : Prop :=
  forall i, SVRel (Γ i) (σ i) (σ' i).

Definition Pval (m:nat) (Γ: ctx m) (V: value m) (A: valtype)
  (H: Γ ⊩ V : A) : Prop :=
  forall (σ σ': fin m -> value 0), EnvRel Γ σ σ' ->
    SVRel A (subst_value σ V) (subst_value σ' V).

Definition Pcomp (m:nat) (Γ: ctx m) (c: comp m) (B: comptype)
  (H: Γ ⊢ c : B) : Prop :=
  forall (σ σ': fin m -> value 0), EnvRel Γ σ σ' ->
    CRel0 B (subst_comp σ c) (subst_comp σ' c).

Arguments Pcomp m Γ c B H : clear implicits.

The fundamental theorem compiles! Huge milestone.

Now we need:
A. Environment-style sstep soundness.
B. Final bridge to comp_obseq.

Let's inspect what we have:
- CRel0 (F A) uses SVRel returned values.
- fundamental_value_comp : for typed V/c under EnvRel, SVRel/CRel0 of substituted terms.
We can use it to get self-relatedness for shared typed terms under envs.

Define for sstep soundness:
For n, Γ, B, terms c c' typed, and σ,σ' EnvRel:
   Goal CRel0 B (c[σ])(c'[σ']).

We induct on sstep c c' (mutual with sstep_value). But the sstep relation is untyped; we carry typing derivations Hc,Hc'. The statement:
```
Lemma sstep_env : forall n (c c': comp n), sstep c c' ->
  forall Γ B (Hc: Γ ⊢ c : B) (Hc': Γ ⊢ c' : B) σ σ', EnvRel Γ σ σ' ->
   CRel0 B (c[σ])(c'[σ']).
with sstep_value_env : forall n (v v': value n), sstep_value v v' ->
  forall Γ A (Hv: Γ ⊩ v : A) (Hv': Γ ⊩ v' : A) σ σ', EnvRel Γ σ σ' ->
   SVRel A (v[σ])(v'[σ']).
```
Problem: sstep rules' subterms may not have typing derivations in Γ *directly available* from the whole typing in a way matching the sstep rule's context. E.g., sstepLambda: c=lambda c0, c'=lambda c0' with c0↪c0' at comp (S n). Whole typing Hc : Γ ⊢ lambda c0 : B gives B=A→B' and Hc0 : A.:Γ ⊢ c0 : B'. Hc' similarly. (* Administrative bigstep laws for primitive steps *)
Lemma BSim_letin_ret (v: value 0) (c2: comp 1) :
  BSim (letin (ret v) c2) (c2[v..]).
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro H.
  - apply bigstep_letin_inv in H as (u & Hu & Hc).
    inversion Hu; subst. exact Hc.
  - eapply bigstepLetin; [apply bigstepReturn|exact H].
Qed.

Lemma BSim_caseS_inj b (v: value 0) (c1 c2: comp 1) :
  BSim (caseS (inj b v) c1 c2) ((if b then c1 else c2)[v..]).
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro H.
  - apply bigstep_caseS_inv in H as (b0 & u & HV & Hc).
    injection HV as -> ->. exact Hc.
  - eapply bigstepCaseS. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma BSim_caseP_pair (v1 v2: value 0) (c: comp 2) :
  BSim (caseP (pair v1 v2) c) (c[scons v2 (scons v1 (@ids value VarInstance_value 0))]).
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro H.
  - apply bigstep_caseP_inv in H as (w1 & w2 & HV & Hc).
    injection HV as -> ->. exact Hc.
  - eapply bigstepCaseP. exact H.
Qed.

(* Substitution helpers for primitive-step commuting *)
Lemma subst_up_app_comp {m n} (c: comp (S m)) (σ: fin m -> value n) (v: value m) :
  (subst_comp (up_value_value σ) c)[(subst_value σ v)..]
  = (c[v..])[σ].
Proof.
  rewrite subst_comp_subst.
  rewrite subst_comp_subst.
  apply subst_comp_congr.
  intros i. destruct i as [i|].
  - simpl. rewrite (up_value_value_app σ (subst_value σ v) i). reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_up_app_comp2 {m n} (c: comp (S (S m))) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (v1 v2: value m) :
  (subst_comp (up_value_value (up_value_value σ)) c)
    [scons (subst_value σ v2) (scons (subst_value σ v1) (@ids value VarInstance_value n))]
  = (c[scons v2 (scons v1 (@ids value VarInstance_value m))])[σ].
Proof.
  rewrite subst_comp_subst.
  rewrite subst_comp_subst.
  apply subst_comp_congr.
  intros i. destruct i as [i|].
  - destruct i as [i|].
    + simpl. rewrite (up_up_value_value_caseP σ (subst_value σ v1) (subst_value σ v2) (Some (Some i))).
      reflexivity.
    + simpl. rewrite (up_up_value_value_caseP σ (subst_value σ v1) (subst_value σ v2) (Some None)).
      reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (up_up_value_value_caseP σ (subst_value σ v1) (subst_value σ v2) None).
    reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

```
Lemma pstep_env : forall n (c c':comp n), pstep c c' ->
  forall Γ B (Hc:Γ⊢c:B)(Hc':Γ⊢c':B) σ σ', EnvRel Γ σ σ' ->

Proof.
  intros n c c' Hp. induction Hp as [c0 | c0 v c' E | b c c1 c2 E | c0 c' v E | v b c c1 c2 E | v1 v2 c c' E]; ...
```
Order pstep constructors: pstepForce, pstepApp, pstepProj, pstepLetin, pstepCaseS, pstepCaseP. The constructor arguments per Semantics:
- pstepForce (c:comp n): force(thunk c) ≽ c.
- pstepApp (c:comp(S n))(c':comp n) v: c[v..]=c' -> (lambda c) v ≽ c'.
- pstepProj (b)(c c1 c2:comp n): c = if b then c1 else c2 -> proj b (tuple c1 c2) ≽ c.
- pstepLetin (c:comp(S n)) c' v: c[v..]=c' -> letin (ret v) c ≽ c'.
- pstepCaseS v b c c1 c2: (if b then c1 else c2)[v..]=c -> caseS (inj b v) c1 c2 ≽ c.
- pstepCaseP v1 v2 c c': c[v2,v1..]=c' -> caseP (pair v1 v2) c ≽ c'.

(* Typing inversions *)
Lemma cty_ret_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {v: value m}
  (H: Γ ⊢ ret v : B) : exists A, B = F A /\ (Γ ⊩ v : A).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma cty_lambda_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {c: comp (S m)}
  (H: Γ ⊢ lambda c : B) :
  exists (A: valtype) (B0: comptype), B = arrow A B0 /\ (A .: Γ ⊢ c : B0).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma cty_app_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {c: comp m} {v: value m}
  (H: Γ ⊢ c v : B) : exists A, (Γ ⊢ c : arrow A B) /\ (Γ ⊩ v : A).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma cty_tuple_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {c1 c2: comp m}
  (H: Γ ⊢ tuple c1 c2 : B) :
  exists B1 B2, B = Pi B1 B2 /\ (Γ ⊢ c1 : B1) /\ (Γ ⊢ c2 : B2).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma cty_proj_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {b: bool} {c: comp m}
  (H: Γ ⊢ proj b c : B) :
  exists B1 B2, (Γ ⊢ c : Pi B1 B2) /\ B = (if b then B1 else B2).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma cty_letin_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {c1: comp m} {c2: comp (S m)}
  (H: Γ ⊢ letin c1 c2 : B) :
  exists A, (Γ ⊢ c1 : F A) /\ (A .: Γ ⊢ c2 : B).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma cty_force_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {v: value m}
  (H: Γ ⊢ force v : B) : Γ ⊩ v : U B.
Proof. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma cty_caseZ_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {v: value m}
  (H: Γ ⊢ caseZ v : B) : Γ ⊩ v : zero.
Proof. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma cty_caseS_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {v: value m}
  {c1 c2: comp (S m)} (H: Γ ⊢ caseS v c1 c2 : B) :
  exists A1 A2, (Γ ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2) /\
    (A1 .: Γ ⊢ c1 : B) /\ (A2 .: Γ ⊢ c2 : B).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma cty_caseP_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {B: comptype} {v: value m}
  {c: comp (S (S m))} (H: Γ ⊢ caseP v c : B) :
  exists A1 A2, (Γ ⊩ v : A1 * A2) /\ (A2 .: (A1 .: Γ) ⊢ c : B).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma vty_thunk_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {A: valtype} {c: comp m}
  (H: Γ ⊩ thunk c : A) : exists B, A = U B /\ (Γ ⊢ c : B).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma vty_pair_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {A: valtype} {v1 v2: value m}
  (H: Γ ⊩ pair v1 v2 : A) :
  exists A1 A2, A = A1 * A2 /\ (Γ ⊩ v1 : A1) /\ (Γ ⊩ v2 : A2).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma vty_inj_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {A: valtype} {b: bool} {v: value m}
  (H: Γ ⊩ inj b v : A) :
  exists A1 A2, A = Sigma A1 A2 /\ (Γ ⊩ v : (if b then A1 else A2)).
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma vty_unit_inv {m} {Γ: ctx m} {A: valtype}
  (H: Γ ⊩ u : A) : A = one.
Proof. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.
EOF

  proj2 (@fundamental_value_comp m Γ) c B H.

Definition SVRel_typed (A:valtype) (V:value 0) (H: null ⊩ V : A) : SVRel A V V.

    EnvRel Γ σ σ' -> CRel0 B (subst_comp σ c) (subst_comp σ' c').

Definition Sval (n:nat) (v v': value n) (s: v ↪ᵥ v') : Prop :=
  forall (Γ: ctx n) A (Hv: Γ ⊩ v : A) (σ σ': fin n -> value 0),
    EnvRel Γ σ σ' -> SVRel A (subst_value σ v) (subst_value σ' v').

  (forall (c c': comp n) (s: c ↪ c'), Scomp n c c' s) /\
  (forall (v v': value n) (s: v ↪ᵥ v'), Sval n v v' s).

6	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
7	(* Basic helper facts about the lifting operations                     *)
8	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

10	Lemma up_value_value_congr {m n} {sigma tau : fin m -> value n}
11	  (H : forall (i : fin m), sigma i = tau i) :
12	  forall (i : fin (S m)), up_value_value sigma i = up_value_value tau i.
13	Proof.
14	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
15	  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp].
16	    change (ren_value shift (sigma x) = ren_value shift (tau x)).
17	    apply f_equal, H.
18	  - reflexivity.
19	Qed.
20	
21	Lemma up_value_value_ids {m} :
22	  forall (i : fin (S m)),
23	    up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value m) i = var_value i.
24	Proof.
25	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
26	  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp]. reflexivity.
27	  - reflexivity.
28	Qed.
29	
30	Lemma up_value_value_ids2 {m} :
31	  forall (i : fin (S (S m))),
32	    up_value_value (up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value m)) i
33	    = var_value i.
34	Proof.
35	  intros i.
36	  transitivity (up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value (S m)) i).
37	  - apply up_value_value_congr. intros j. apply up_value_value_ids.
38	  - apply up_value_value_ids.
39	Qed.

44	Proof.

53	  forall (i : fin (S m)),

58	  - reflexivity.

  (forall r, c1 ▷ r <-> c1' ▷ r) -> BSim (letin c1 c2) (letin c1' c2).
Proof.

Lemma pstep_BSim : forall n (c c': comp n), pstep c c' -> BSim c c'.

A convenient way is a single mutual `Fixpoint` over the four context families, but since `cctx`/`vctx` are indexed by a bool `t`, you may instead define by induction on the context with `dependent destruction`-style `inversion`/`destruct C`; note that for `t=true`, some `cctx`/`vctx` constructors have impossible `(if t then ... else ...)` fields and can be dismissed by destructing the boolean/index. The expected result in each constructor follows directly from the corresponding `sstep`/`sstep_value` congruence constructor, e.g.:
- `cctxLambda C` gives `sstepLambda` applied to IH.
- `cctxAppL C v` gives `sstepAppL`; `cctxAppR c C` uses `sstepAppR` with IH on the value context.
- constructors with value sub-contexts need `sstep_fillv_*`.
- `vctxThunk C` uses `sstepValueThunk` with IH on the comp context.
- pair/inj use `sstepValuePairL/R`, `sstepValueInj`.
Look at CBPV.ProgramContexts for the exact constructors of `vctx`/`cctx` and the fill functions, and CBPV.StrongReduction for `sstep`/`sstep_value` constructors.

At the end, provide a small corollary (optional but useful):
```

  star sstep c c' -> star sstep (fillc C c) (fillc C c').
```

134	| cctxTypingAppR n (Delta: ctx n) c (C: vctx t m n) A A' B :

138	| cctxTypingTupleL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B1 B2 A c:
139	    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B1; A ->
140	    Gamma ⊢ c : B2  ->
141	    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxTupleL C c : Pi B1 B2; A
142	| cctxTypingTupleR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B1 B2 A c:
143	    Gamma ⊢ c : B1  ->

146	| cctxTypingRet n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A':
147	    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊩ C : A; A' ->
148	    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxRet C : F A; A'
149	| cctxTypingLetinL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A A' B c:
150	    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : F A; A' ->
151	    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B  ->

153	| cctxTypingLetinR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A A' B c:
154	    Gamma ⊢ c : F A  ->
155	    (A .: Gamma)[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->

157	| cctxTypingProj n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A B1 B2 (b: bool):

163	| cctxTypingCaseSV n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A1 A2 A' B c1 c2:
164	    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : Sigma A1 A2; A' ->
165	    A1 .: Gamma ⊢ c1 : B  ->
166	    A2 .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B  ->
167	    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 : B; A'
168	| cctxTypingCaseSL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A1 A2 A' B v c2:
169	    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2  ->

171	    A2 .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B  ->
172	    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSL v C c2 : B; A'

174	    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2  ->
175	    A1 .: Gamma ⊢ c1 : B  ->

202	
203	  match C in vctx _ _ n return (if t1 then vctx t2 n k else cctx t2 n k) -> vctx t2 m k  with
204	  | vctxHole _ _ H =>

208	    end H

218	  | cctxHole _ _ H =>
219	    match t1 return (if t1 then False else True) -> (if t1 then vctx t2 m k else cctx t2 m k)  -> cctx t2 m k  with
220	    | false => fun _ C' => C'
221	    | true => fun f _ => match f with end
222	    end H
223	  | cctxForce C => fun C' => cctxForce (plugvctx C C')
224	  | cctxLambda C => fun C' => cctxLambda (plugcctx C C')
225	  | cctxAppL C v => fun C' => cctxAppL (plugcctx C C') v
226	  | cctxAppR c C => fun C' => cctxAppR c (plugvctx C C')
227	  | cctxTupleL C c => fun C' => cctxTupleL (plugcctx C C') c
228	  | cctxTupleR c C => fun C' => cctxTupleR c (plugcctx C C')

237	  | cctxCasePV C c => fun C' => cctxCasePV (plugvctx C C') c

17	Inductive value_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : value m -> valtype -> Type :=
18	| typeVar i : Gamma ⊩ var_value i : Gamma i
19	| typeUnit: Gamma ⊩ u : one
20	| typePair v1 v2 A1 A2:
21	    Gamma ⊩ v1 : A1 -> Gamma ⊩ v2 : A2 -> Gamma ⊩ pair v1 v2 : cross A1 A2
22	| typeSum A1 A2 (b: bool) v:
23	    Gamma ⊩ v : (if b then A1 else A2) -> Gamma ⊩ inj b v : Sigma A1 A2
24	| typeThunk c A:
25	    Gamma ⊢ c : A -> Gamma ⊩ thunk c : U A
26	where "Gamma ⊩ v : A" := (value_typing Gamma v A)
27
