29	with computation_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : comp m -> comptype -> Type :=
30	| typeCone: Gamma ⊢ cu : cone
31	| typeLambda (c: comp (S m)) A B:
32	    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B -> (Gamma ⊢ lambda c : A → B)
33	| typeLetin c1 c2 A B:
34	    Gamma ⊢ c1 : F A -> A .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B -> Gamma ⊢ $ <- c1; c2 : B
35	| typeRet v A:
36	    Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ ret v : F A
37	| typeApp c v A B:
38	    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B -> Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ c v : B
39	| typeTuple c1 c2 B1 B2:
40	    Gamma ⊢ c1 : B1  -> Gamma ⊢ c2 : B2 -> Gamma ⊢ tuple c1 c2 : Pi B1 B2
41	| typeProj b c B1 B2:
42	    Gamma ⊢ c : Pi B1 B2 -> Gamma ⊢ proj b c : (if b then B1 else B2)
43	| typeForce v A:
44	    Gamma ⊩ v : U A -> Gamma ⊢ v! : A
45	| typeCaseZ v A: Gamma ⊩ v : zero -> Gamma ⊢ caseZ v : A
46	| typeCaseS v c1 c2 A1 A2 C:
47	    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2 ->
48	    A1, Gamma ⊢ c1 : C ->
49	    A2, Gamma ⊢ c2 : C ->
50	    Gamma ⊢ caseS v c1 c2 : C
51	| typeCaseP v c A B C:
52	    Gamma ⊩ v : A * B ->
53	    B, A, Gamma  ⊢ c : C ->
54	    Gamma ⊢ caseP v c : C
55	where "Gamma ⊢ c : A" := (@computation_typing _ Gamma c A).

10	Lemma up_value_value_congr {m n} {sigma tau : fin m -> value n}
11	  (H : forall (i : fin m), sigma i = tau i) :
12	  forall (i : fin (S m)), up_value_value sigma i = up_value_value tau i.
13	Proof.
14	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
15	  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp].
16	    change (ren_value shift (sigma x) = ren_value shift (tau x)).
17	    apply f_equal, H.
18	  - reflexivity.
19	Qed.
20	
21	Lemma up_value_value_ids {m} :
22	  forall (i : fin (S m)),
23	    up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value m) i = var_value i.
24	Proof.
25	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
26	  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp]. reflexivity.
27	  - reflexivity.
28	Qed.
29	
30	Lemma up_value_value_ids2 {m} :
31	  forall (i : fin (S (S m))),
32	    up_value_value (up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value m)) i
33	    = var_value i.
34	Proof.
35	  intros i.
36	  transitivity (up_value_value (@ids value VarInstance_value (S m)) i).
37	  - apply up_value_value_congr. intros j. apply up_value_value_ids.
38	  - apply up_value_value_ids.
39	Qed.

41	Lemma up_ren_congr {m n} {xi xi' : fin m -> fin n}
42	  (H : forall (i : fin m), xi i = xi' i) :
43	  forall (i : fin (S m)), up_ren xi i = up_ren xi' i.
44	Proof.
45	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
46	  - cbn [up_ren scons funcomp shift bound].
47	    change (Some (xi x) = Some (xi' x)).
48	    apply f_equal, H.
49	  - reflexivity.
50	Qed.

52	Lemma up_ren_comp {m n k} (xi1 : fin m -> fin n) (xi2 : fin n -> fin k) :
53	  forall (i : fin (S m)),
54	    up_ren (fun i => xi2 (xi1 i)) i = up_ren xi2 (up_ren xi1 i).
55	Proof.
56	  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
57	  - cbn [up_ren scons funcomp shift bound]. reflexivity.
58	  - reflexivity.
59	Qed.

63	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

65	Fixpoint ren_value_congr {m n} (V : value m) {xi xi' : fin m -> fin n}
66	  (H : forall (i : fin m), xi i = xi' i) {struct V} :
67	  ren_value xi V = ren_value xi' V
68	with ren_comp_congr {m n} (c : comp m) {xi xi' : fin m -> fin n}
69	  (H : forall (i : fin m), xi i = xi' i) {struct c} :
70	  ren_comp xi c = ren_comp xi' c.
71	Proof.
72	  - destruct V; simpl.
73	    + apply f_equal, H.
74	    + reflexivity.
75	    + apply f_equal2; apply ren_value_congr; exact H.
76	    + apply f_equal2; [ reflexivity | apply ren_value_congr; exact H ].
77	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_comp_congr. exact H.
78	  - destruct c; simpl.
79	    + reflexivity.
80	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_value_congr. exact H.
81	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_comp_congr. apply up_ren_congr. exact H.
82	    + apply f_equal2; [ apply ren_comp_congr; exact H | apply ren_value_congr; exact H ].
83	    + apply f_equal2; apply ren_comp_congr; exact H.
84	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_value_congr. exact H.
85	    + apply f_equal2; [ apply ren_comp_congr; exact H
86	                       | apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_congr; exact H ].
87	    + apply f_equal2; [ reflexivity | apply ren_comp_congr; exact H ].
88	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_value_congr. exact H.
89	    + apply f_equal3; [ apply ren_value_congr; exact H
90	                       | apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_congr; exact H
91	                       | apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_congr; exact H ].
92	    + apply f_equal2; [ apply ren_value_congr; exact H
93	                       | apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_congr; apply up_ren_congr; exact H ].

100	Fixpoint ren_value_comp {m n k} (xi1 : fin m -> fin n) (xi2 : fin n -> fin k)
101	  (V : value m) {struct V} :
102	  ren_value (fun i => xi2 (xi1 i)) V = ren_value xi2 (ren_value xi1 V)

104	  (c : comp m) {struct c} :
105	  ren_comp (fun i => xi2 (xi1 i)) c = ren_comp xi2 (ren_comp xi1 c).

109	    + reflexivity.

112	    + apply f_equal. apply ren_comp_comp.

118	      * apply ren_comp_congr. apply up_ren_comp.
119	      * apply ren_comp_comp.

121	    + apply f_equal2; apply ren_comp_comp.

132	          [ apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_comp | apply ren_comp_comp ]
133	        | transitivity (ren_comp (fun i => up_ren xi2 (up_ren xi1 i)) c2);
134	          [ apply ren_comp_congr; apply up_ren_comp | apply ren_comp_comp ] ].

137	        | transitivity (ren_comp (fun i => up_ren (up_ren xi2) (up_ren (up_ren xi1) i)) c);

173	                  | apply subst_comp_congr; apply up_value_value_congr; exact H
174	                  | apply subst_comp_congr; apply up_value_value_congr; exact H ].

211	    + apply f_equal. apply subst_value_id.

300	      * apply ren_value_congr. intros l.
301	        cbn [up_ren scons funcomp shift bound]. reflexivity.
302	      * apply ren_value_comp.
303	  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp up_ren shift bound]. reflexivity.

358	Lemma up_value_value_subst {m n k} (sigma : fin m -> value n) (tau : fin n -> value k) :
359	  forall (i : fin (S m)),

367	    rewrite (ren_value_subst shift (sigma j) (up_value_value tau)).
368	    transitivity (subst_value (fun l => ren_value shift (tau l)) (sigma j)).
369	    + apply subst_value_congr. intros l. reflexivity.
370	    + symmetry. apply subst_value_ren.
371	  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp up_ren shift bound]. reflexivity.

436	               (scons v (@ids value VarInstance_value n))).

439	    + apply subst_value_id.

500	(* Strong (structural) value relation; VRel0 adds syntactic equality so arrow
501	   transitivity has a reflexive argument relation. *)
502	Fixpoint SVRel (A: valtype) (V W: value 0) {struct A} : Prop :=
503	  match A with
504	  | zero => V = W
505	  | one => V = W
506	  | U B => exists c c', V = thunk c /\ W = thunk c' /\ CRel0 B c c'
507	  | Sigma A1 A2 => exists b v v', V = inj b v /\ W = inj b v' /\
508	       (if b then SVRel A1 v v' else SVRel A2 v v')
509	  | cross A1 A2 => exists v1 v2 w1 w2, V = pair v1 v2 /\ W = pair w1 w2 /\
510	       SVRel A1 v1 w1 /\ SVRel A2 v2 w2
511	  end
512	with CRel0 (B: comptype) (c c': comp 0) {struct B} : Prop :=
513	  match B with
514	  | cone => True
515	  | F A => (forall v, c ▷ ret v -> exists v', c' ▷ ret v' /\ SVRel A v v')
516	        /\ (forall v', c' ▷ ret v' -> exists v, c ▷ ret v /\ SVRel A v v')
517	  | Pi B1 B2 => CRel0 B2 (proj false c) (proj false c') /\
518	                CRel0 B1 (proj true c) (proj true c')
519	  | arrow A B => forall v v', SVRel A v v' -> CRel0 B (c v)(c' v')
520	  end.
521	
522	Definition VRel0 (A: valtype) (V W: value 0) : Prop := SVRel A V W.
523	
524	Lemma SVRel_to_VRel0 A V W : SVRel A V W -> VRel0 A V W.
525	Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.
526	
527	(* Symmetry of SVRel and CRel0; VRel0 later. *)
528	Fixpoint SVRel_sym (A: valtype) (V W: value 0) {struct A} : SVRel A V W -> SVRel A W V
529	with CRel0_sym (B: comptype) (c c': comp 0) {struct B} : CRel0 B c c' -> CRel0 B c' c.
530	Proof.
531	  - destruct A; simpl.
532	    + intros H. symmetry. exact H.
533	    + intros H. symmetry. exact H.
534	    + intros (cc & cc' & E & E' & H).
535	      exists cc', cc. split.
536	      * exact E'.
537	      * split.
538	        -- exact E.
539	        -- apply CRel0_sym. exact H.
540	    + intros (b & u & u' & E & E' & H).
541	      exists b, u', u. split.
542	      * exact E'.
543	      * split.
544	        -- exact E.
545	        -- destruct b; [apply SVRel_sym|apply SVRel_sym]; exact H.
546	    + intros (v1 & v2 & w1 & w2 & E & E' & H1 & H2).
547	      exists w1, w2, v1, v2. split.
548	      * exact E'.
549	      * split.
550	        -- exact E.
551	        -- split.
552	           ++ apply SVRel_sym. exact H1.
553	           ++ apply SVRel_sym. exact H2.
554	  - destruct B; simpl.
555	    + intros _. exact I.
556	    + intros (H1 & H2). split.
557	      * intros vv HH. destruct (H2 vv HH) as (u & Hu & HV).
558	        exists u. split; [exact Hu|apply SVRel_sym; exact HV].
559	      * intros vv HH. destruct (H1 vv HH) as (u & Hu & HV).
560	        exists u. split; [exact Hu|apply SVRel_sym; exact HV].
561	    + intros (H1 & H2). split.
562	      * apply CRel0_sym. exact H1.
563	      * apply CRel0_sym. exact H2.
564	    + intros H a b HV.
565	      apply CRel0_sym.
566	      apply H.
567	      apply SVRel_sym. exact HV.
568	Qed.

570	Lemma VRel0_sym A V W : VRel0 A V W -> VRel0 A W V.
571	Proof. intros H. apply SVRel_sym. exact H. Qed.

698	(* Evaluation stacks of applications/projections *)
699	Inductive ctxstack : comptype -> comptype -> Type :=
700	| cs_hole : forall B, ctxstack B B
701	| cs_projL : forall B B1 B2, ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2) -> ctxstack B B2
702	| cs_projR : forall B B1 B2, ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2) -> ctxstack B B1
703	| cs_app : forall B A C, ctxstack B (arrow A C) -> value 0 -> ctxstack B C.
704	
705	Fixpoint apply_stack {B C} (K: ctxstack B C) (c: comp 0) : comp 0 :=
706	  match K in ctxstack _ C return comp 0 with
707	  | cs_hole _ => c
708	  | cs_projL K0 => proj false (apply_stack K0 c)
709	  | cs_projR K0 => proj true (apply_stack K0 c)
710	  | cs_app K0 v => apply_stack K0 c v
711	  end.
712	
713	Inductive stack_pair : forall B C, ctxstack B C -> ctxstack B C -> Prop :=
714	| sp_hole B : stack_pair (cs_hole B) (cs_hole B)
715	| sp_projL : forall B B1 B2 (K K' : ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2)),
716	      stack_pair K K' -> stack_pair (cs_projL K) (cs_projL K')
717	| sp_projR : forall B B1 B2 (K K' : ctxstack B (Pi B1 B2)),
718	      stack_pair K K' -> stack_pair (cs_projR K) (cs_projR K')
719	| sp_app : forall B A C (K K' : ctxstack B (arrow A C)) v v',
720	      stack_pair K K' -> VRel0 A v v' -> stack_pair (cs_app K v) (cs_app K' v').
721	
722	Lemma stack_compat : forall B C (K K': ctxstack B C),
723	  stack_pair K K' -> forall Z Z', CRel0 B Z Z' ->
724	  CRel0 C (apply_stack K Z) (apply_stack K' Z').
725	Proof.
726	  intros B C K K' SP. induction SP as
727	    [B|B B1 B2 K K' SP IH|B B1 B2 K K' SP IH|B A C K K' v v' SP IH HV];
728	    intros Z Z' HZ.
729	  - simpl. exact HZ.
730	  - simpl. exact (proj1 (IH Z Z' HZ)).
731	  - simpl. exact (proj2 (IH Z Z' HZ)).
732	  - simpl. exact (IH Z Z' HZ v v' HV).
733	Qed.

735	Lemma let_decomp : forall (B C: comptype) (K: ctxstack B C) X Y r,
736	  apply_stack K (letin X Y) ▷ r ->
737	  exists u, X ▷ ret u /\ apply_stack K (Y[u..]) ▷ r.
738	Proof.
739	  intros B C K. induction K as
740	    [B|B B1 B2 K0 IHK|B B1 B2 K0 IHK|B A C K0 IHK v];
741	    intros X Y r H.
742	  - simpl in H. apply bigstep_letin_inv in H. exact H.
743	  - simpl in H. apply bigstep_proj_inv in H as (a & b & Hp & Hr).
744	    destruct (IHK X Y (tuple a b) Hp) as (u & Hx & Hy).
745	    exists u. split; [exact Hx|]. simpl. eapply bigstepProj; eassumption.
746	  - simpl in H. apply bigstep_proj_inv in H as (a & b & Hp & Hr).
747	    destruct (IHK X Y (tuple a b) Hp) as (u & Hx & Hy).
748	    exists u. split; [exact Hx|]. simpl. eapply bigstepProj; eassumption.
749	  - simpl in H. apply bigstep_app_inv in H as (c0 & Hp & Hr).
750	    destruct (IHK X Y (lambda c0) Hp) as (u & Hx & Hy).
751	    exists u. split; [exact Hx|]. simpl. eapply bigstepApp; eassumption.
752	Qed.

783	(* Bind (letin) is compatible with the logical relation, for any stack and
784	   any result type. *)
785	Lemma bind_letin_stack : forall (C B: comptype) (K K': ctxstack B C),
786	  stack_pair K K' -> forall (A: valtype) X X' Y Y',
787	  CRel0 (F A) X X' ->
788	  (forall u u', SVRel A u u' -> CRel0 B (Y[u..]) (Y'[u'..])) ->
789	  CRel0 C (apply_stack K (letin X Y)) (apply_stack K' (letin X' Y')).
790	Proof.
791	  induction C as [|A0|C1 IHC1 C2 IHC2|A0 C1 IHC1]; intros B K K' SP A X X' Y Y' HX HY.
792	  - simpl. exact I.
793	  - (* C = F A0 *)
794	    destruct HX as (HX1 & HX2).
795	    split.
796	    + intros v Hv.
797	      destruct (let_decomp K X Y (ret v) Hv) as (u & Hu & Hku).
798	      destruct (HX1 u Hu) as (u' & Hu' & Hsu).
799	      pose proof (HY u u' Hsu) as Hc.
800	      pose proof (stack_compat SP (Y[u..]) (Y'[u'..]) Hc) as Hcom.
801	      cbn [CRel0] in Hcom. destruct Hcom as (Hcom1 & _).
802	      destruct (Hcom1 v Hku) as (v' & Hv' & Hsv).
803	      exists v'. split; [|exact Hsv].
804	      eapply let_decomp_rev; [exact Hu'|exact Hv'].
805	    + intros v' Hv'.
806	      destruct (let_decomp K' X' Y' (ret v') Hv') as (u' & Hu' & Hku').
807	      destruct (HX2 u' Hu') as (u & Hu & Hsu).
808	      pose proof (HY u u' Hsu) as Hc.
809	      pose proof (stack_compat SP (Y[u..]) (Y'[u'..]) Hc) as Hcom.
810	      cbn [CRel0] in Hcom. destruct Hcom as (_ & Hcom2).
811	      destruct (Hcom2 v' Hku') as (v & Hv & Hsv).
812	      exists v. split; [|exact Hsv].
813	      eapply let_decomp_rev; [exact Hu|exact Hv].
814	  - (* C = Pi C1 C2 *)
815	    split.
816	    + eapply (IHC2 B (cs_projL K) (cs_projL K')).
817	      * apply sp_projL. exact SP.
818	      * exact HX.
819	      * exact HY.
820	    + eapply (IHC1 B (cs_projR K) (cs_projR K')).
821	      * apply sp_projR. exact SP.
822	      * exact HX.
823	      * exact HY.
824	  - (* C = arrow A0 C1 *)
825	    intros v v' HV.
826	    eapply (IHC1 B (cs_app K v) (cs_app K' v')).
827	    + apply sp_app with (v:=v)(v':=v').
828	      * exact SP.
829	      * exact HV.
830	    + exact HX.
831	    + exact HY.
832	Qed.

882	Lemma bind_caseS_stack : forall (C Bres: comptype) (K K': ctxstack Bres C),
883	  stack_pair K K' ->
884	  forall A1 A2 (V V': value 0) (c1 c1' c2 c2': comp 1),
885	  SVRel (Sigma A1 A2) V V' ->
886	  (forall u u', SVRel A1 u u' -> CRel0 Bres (c1[u..]) (c1'[u'..])) ->
887	  (forall u u', SVRel A2 u u' -> CRel0 Bres (c2[u..]) (c2'[u'..])) ->
888	  CRel0 C (apply_stack K (caseS V c1 c2))
889	           (apply_stack K' (caseS V' c1' c2')).
890	Proof.
891	  induction C as [|A0|C1 IHC1 C2 IHC2|A0 C1 IHC1];
892	    intros Bres K K' SP A1 A2 V V' c1 c1' c2 c2' HV H1 H2.
893	  - simpl. exact I.
894	  - (* C = F A0 *)
895	    destruct HV as (b & u & u' & Ev & Ev' & Hvu).
896	    split.
897	    + intros v Hv.
898	      destruct (caseS_decomp K V c1 c2 (ret v) Hv) as (b0 & w & HV0 & Hkv).
899	      rewrite Ev in HV0. injection HV0 as Hb Hw. subst b0. subst u.
900	      assert (Hc : CRel0 Bres ((if b then c1 else c2)[w..])
901	                        ((if b then c1' else c2')[u'..])).
902	      { destruct b; simpl in *; [apply H1|apply H2]; exact Hvu. }
903	      pose proof (stack_compat SP _ _ Hc) as Hcom.
904	      cbn [CRel0] in Hcom. destruct Hcom as (Hcom1 & _).
905	        destruct (Hcom1 v Hkv) as (v' & Hv' & Hsv).
906	        exists v'. split; [|exact Hsv].
907	        eapply caseS_decomp_rev; [exact Ev'|exact Hv'].
908	    + intros v' Hv'.
909	      destruct (caseS_decomp K' V' c1' c2' (ret v') Hv') as (b0 & w' & HV0 & Hkv').
910	      rewrite Ev' in HV0. injection HV0 as Hb Hw. subst b0. subst u'.
911	      assert (Hc : CRel0 Bres ((if b then c1 else c2)[u..])
912	                        ((if b then c1' else c2')[w'..])).
913	      { destruct b; simpl in *; [apply H1|apply H2]; exact Hvu. }
914	      pose proof (stack_compat SP _ _ Hc) as Hcom.
915	      cbn [CRel0] in Hcom. destruct Hcom as (_ & Hcom2).
916	        destruct (Hcom2 v' Hkv') as (v & Hv & Hsv).
917	        exists v. split; [|exact Hsv].
918	        eapply caseS_decomp_rev; [exact Ev|exact Hv].
919	  - (* C = Pi C1 C2 *)
920	    split.
921	    + eapply (IHC2 Bres (cs_projL K) (cs_projL K')).
922	      * apply sp_projL. exact SP.
923	      * exact HV.
924	      * exact H1.
925	      * exact H2.
926	    + eapply (IHC1 Bres (cs_projR K) (cs_projR K')).
927	      * apply sp_projR. exact SP.
928	      * exact HV.
929	      * exact H1.
930	      * exact H2.
931	  - (* C = arrow A0 C1 *)
932	    intros v v' HVv.
933	    eapply (IHC1 Bres (cs_app K v) (cs_app K' v')).
934	    + apply sp_app with (v:=v)(v':=v').
935	      * exact SP.
936	      * exact HVv.
937	    + exact HV.
938	    + exact H1.
939	    + exact H2.
940	Qed.

1065	    + intros vv Hv. exfalso. exact (Hc' (ret vv) Hv).

1074	    apply CRel0_no_bigstep.
1075	    + apply no_bigstep_app. exact Hc.
1076	    + apply no_bigstep_app. exact Hc'.

(* Ground-value relation is syntactic equality, hence observations agree. *)
Fixpoint SVRel_ground_eq (G: groundtype) : forall V W: value 0,
  SVRel (to_valtype G) V W -> V = W.
Proof.
  destruct G as [|G1 IH1 G2 IH2|G1 IH1 G2 IH2]; simpl.
  - intros V W H. exact H.
  - intros V W (b & v & w & EV & EW & H).
    subst V. subst W. f_equal.
    destruct b; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; exact H.
  - intros V W (v1 & v2 & w1 & w2 & EV & EW & H1 & H2).
    subst V. subst W. f_equal.
    + apply IH1. exact H1.
    + apply IH2. exact H2.
Qed.

Definition Raw_star (c c': comp 0) : Prop :=
  forall v, c >* ret v <-> c' >* ret v.

Lemma Raw_star_refl c : Raw_star c c.
Proof. intros v. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma Raw_star_sym c c' : Raw_star c c' -> Raw_star c' c.
Proof. intros H v. symmetry. apply H. Qed.

Lemma Raw_star_trans c c' c'' : Raw_star c c' -> Raw_star c' c'' -> Raw_star c c''.
Proof. intros H1 H2 v. transitivity (c' >* ret v); [apply H1|apply H2]. Qed.

Lemma CRel0_F_ground_raw_star (G: groundtype) (c c': comp 0) :
  CRel0 (F (to_valtype G)) c c' -> Raw_star c c'.
Proof.
  intros (H1 & H2) v. split; intro Hv.
  - destruct (H1 v Hv) as (v' & Hv' & HV).
    rewrite (SVRel_ground_eq G v v' HV). exact Hv'.
  - destruct (H2 v Hv) as (v' & Hv' & HV).
    rewrite (SVRel_ground_eq G v v' HV). exact Hv'.
Qed.

(* CRel0 at ground-return type gives star-step observation equivalence *)
Lemma CRel0_F_ground_obs (G: groundtype) (c c': comp 0) :
  CRel0 (F (to_valtype G)) c c' -> forall v, c >* ret v <-> c' >* ret v.
Proof.
  intros H. apply CRel0_F_ground_raw_star in H. exact H.
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Tmp.All.

Lemma up_lift_eq {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (A: valtype) :
  forall i : fin (S m), (A .: Δ) i = (A .: Γ) (up_ren ξ i).
Proof.
  intros i. destruct i as [i|]; simpl.
  - change (Δ i = Γ (ξ i)). apply Hξ.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_value_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (v: value m) (A: valtype)
  (H: Δ ⊩ v : A) {struct H} : Γ ⊩ ren_value ξ v : A
with ren_comp_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (c: comp m) (B: comptype)
  (H: Δ ⊢ c : B) {struct H} : Γ ⊢ ren_comp ξ c : B.
Proof.
  - (* value *) simpl.
    destruct H; simpl.
    + (* typeVar *)
      exact (match eq_sym (Hξ i) in (_ = T') return (Γ ⊩ var_value (ξ i) : T') with
             | eq_refl => @typeVar _ Γ (ξ i)
             end).
    + apply typeUnit.
    + apply typePair.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
    + apply typeSum.
      eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
    + apply typeThunk.
      eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
  - (* comp *) simpl.
    destruct H; simpl.
    + apply typeCone.
    + apply typeForce.
      eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
    + apply typeLambda.
      eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := A .: Δ) (Γ := A .: Γ) (ξ := up_ren ξ)
                                 (Hξ := up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A)).
      assumption.
    + apply typeApp.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
    + apply typeTuple.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
    + apply typeRet.
      eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
    + apply typeLetin.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := A .: Δ) (Γ := A .: Γ) (ξ := up_ren ξ)
                                   (Hξ := up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A)).
        assumption.
    + apply typeProj.
      eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
    + apply typeCaseZ.
      eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
    + apply typeCaseS.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := A1 .: Δ) (Γ := A1 .: Γ) (ξ := up_ren ξ)
                                   (Hξ := up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A1)).
        assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := A2 .: Δ) (Γ := A2 .: Γ) (ξ := up_ren ξ)
                                   (Hξ := up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A2)).
        assumption.
    + apply typeCaseP.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ) (Hξ := Hξ)). assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := B .: (A .: Δ)) (Γ := B .: (A .: Γ))
                                   (ξ := up_ren (up_ren ξ))
                                   (Hξ := up_lift_eq (A .: Γ) (A .: Δ) (up_ren ξ)
                                                     (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A) B)).
        assumption.
Qed.

Lemma up_value_value_congr {m n} {sigma tau : fin m -> value n}
  (H : forall (i : fin m), sigma i = tau i) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)), up_value_value sigma i = up_value_value tau i.
Proof.
  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp].
    change (ren_value shift (sigma x) = ren_value shift (tau x)).
    apply f_equal, H.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Tmp.All.
Require Import CBPV.ProgramContexts.
Import CommaNotation.

(* The type of the object that can be plugged in a hole of kind [t]:
   a value when [t = true], a computation when [t = false].  The typing
   judgment for that object is packaged in [input_typing]. *)

Definition input_typing {n: nat} (t: bool) (Delta: ctx n)
  (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
  (x: if t then value n else comp n) : Type :=
  match t as b return
    (if b then valtype else comptype) ->
    (if b then value n else comp n) -> Type
  with
  | true  => fun T v => Delta ⊩ v : T
  | false => fun T c => Delta ⊢ c : T
  end T x.

(* The two simultaneous statements, parameterised over the bool index [t]. *)

Definition Pv : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m) (n: nat)
    (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) (A: valtype)
    (T: if t then valtype else comptype),
    (Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T) -> Prop :=
  fun m t Gamma n Delta C A T H =>
    forall x, @input_typing n t Delta T x -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C x : A.

Definition Pc : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m) (n: nat)
    (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) (B: comptype)
    (T: if t then valtype else comptype),
    (Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T) -> Prop :=
  fun m t Gamma n Delta C B T H =>
    forall x, @input_typing n t Delta T x -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C x : B.

Lemma fill_typing_all : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m),
  (forall (n: nat) (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) (A: valtype)
     (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
     (H: Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T),
      Pv m t Gamma n Delta C A T H)
  /\
  (forall (n: nat) (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) (B: comptype)
     (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
     (H: Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T),
      Pc m t Gamma n Delta C B T H).
Proof.
  intros m t Gamma.
  apply (mutindt_vctx_cctx_typing Pv Pc).
  - (* vctxTypingHole *)
    destruct t; simpl.
    + intros x Hx. exact Hx.
    + destruct H.
  - (* vctxTypingPairL *)
    intros IH hv x Hx. simpl. apply typePair.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hv.
  - (* vctxTypingPairR *)
    intros IH hv x Hx. simpl. apply typePair.
    + exact hv.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* vctxTypingInj *)
    intros IH x Hx. simpl. apply typeSum. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* vctxTypingThunk *)
    intros IH x Hx. simpl. apply typeThunk. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingHole *)
    destruct t; simpl.
    + destruct H.
    + intros x Hx. exact Hx.
  - (* cctxTypingLambda *)
    intros IH x Hx. simpl. apply typeLambda. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingForce *)
    intros IH x Hx. simpl. apply typeForce. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingAppL *)
    intros IH hv x Hx. simpl. apply typeApp.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hv.
  - (* cctxTypingAppR *)
    intros IH hc x Hx. simpl. apply typeApp.
    + exact hc.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingTupleL *)
    intros IH hc x Hx. simpl. apply typeTuple.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hc.
  - (* cctxTypingTupleR *)
    intros IH hc x Hx. simpl. apply typeTuple.
    + exact hc.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingRet *)
    intros IH x Hx. simpl. apply typeRet. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingLetinL *)
    intros IH hc x Hx. simpl. apply typeLetin.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hc.
  - (* cctxTypingLetinR *)
    intros IH hc x Hx. simpl. apply typeLetin.
    + exact hc.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingProj *)
    intros IH x Hx. simpl. apply typeProj. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCaseZ *)
    intros IH x Hx. simpl. apply typeCaseZ. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSV *)
    intros IH hc1 hc2 x Hx. simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hc1.
    + exact hc2.
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSL *)
    intros IH hv hc2 x Hx. simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact hv.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hc2.
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSR *)
    intros IH hv hc1 x Hx. simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact hv.
    + exact hc1.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCasePV *)
    intros IH hc x Hx. simpl. apply typeCaseP.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hc.
  - (* cctxTypingCasePC *)
    intros IH hv x Hx. simpl. apply typeCaseP.
    + exact hv.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
Qed.

Lemma fillc_typing_false : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: cctx false m n) (B: comptype) (A: comptype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; A ->
  forall (c: comp n), Delta ⊢ c : A -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C c : B.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C B A H c Hc.
  exact (proj2 (fill_typing_all m false Gamma) n Delta C B A H c Hc).
Qed.

Lemma fillc_typing_true : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: cctx true m n) (B: comptype) (A: valtype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; A ->
  forall (v: value n), Delta ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C v : B.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C B A H v Hv.
  exact (proj2 (fill_typing_all m true Gamma) n Delta C B A H v Hv).
Qed.

Lemma fillv_typing_true : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: vctx true m n) (A: valtype) (T: valtype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T ->
  forall (v: value n), Delta ⊩ v : T -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C v : A.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C A T H v Hv.
  exact (proj1 (fill_typing_all m true Gamma) n Delta C A T H v Hv).
Qed.

Lemma fillv_typing_false : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: vctx false m n) (A: valtype) (T: comptype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T ->
  forall (c: comp n), Delta ⊢ c : T -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C c : A.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C A T H c Hc.
  exact (proj1 (fill_typing_all m false Gamma) n Delta C A T H c Hc).
Qed.

Lemma fillc_typing_closing : forall n (Gamma: ctx n) (C: cctx false 0 n)
  (G: groundtype) (A: comptype),
  null [[ Gamma ]] ⊢ C : F G ; A ->
  forall (c: comp n), Gamma ⊢ c : A -> (null ⊢ fillc C c : F G).
Proof.
  intros n Gamma C G A H c Hc.
  apply fillc_typing_false with (Delta := Gamma). exact H.
  exact Hc.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Tmp.All.
Require Import CBPV.ObservationalEquivalence CBPV.StrongReduction CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems.
Import CommaNotation.
Typeclasses Transparent Subst_comp Subst_value.

Lemma up_lift_eq {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (A: valtype) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)), (A .: Δ) i = (A .: Γ) (up_ren ξ i).
Proof.
  intros i. destruct i as [i|]; simpl.
  - change (Δ i = Γ (ξ i)). apply Hξ.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_value_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (v: value m) (A: valtype)
  (H: Δ ⊩ v : A) {struct H} : Γ ⊩ ren_value ξ v : A
with ren_comp_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (c: comp m) (B: comptype)
  (H: Δ ⊢ c : B) {struct H} : Γ ⊢ ren_comp ξ c : B.
Proof.
  - (* value *) simpl.
    destruct H; simpl.
    + (* typeVar *)
      exact (match eq_sym (Hξ i) in (_ = T') return (Γ ⊩ var_value (ξ i) : T') with
             | eq_refl => @typeVar _ Γ (ξ i)
             end).
    + apply typeUnit.
    + apply typePair.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
    + apply typeSum.
      eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
    + apply typeThunk.
      eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
  - (* comp *) simpl.
    destruct H; simpl.
    + apply typeCone.
    + apply typeForce.
      eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
    + apply typeLambda.
      eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := A .: Δ) (Γ := A .: Γ) (ξ := up_ren ξ)).
      * apply (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A).
      * assumption.
    + apply typeApp.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
    + apply typeTuple.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
    + apply typeRet.
      eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
    + apply typeLetin.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := A .: Δ) (Γ := A .: Γ) (ξ := up_ren ξ)).
        -- apply (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A).
        -- assumption.
    + apply typeProj.
      eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
    + apply typeCaseZ.
      eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
    + apply typeCaseS.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := A1 .: Δ) (Γ := A1 .: Γ) (ξ := up_ren ξ)).
        -- apply (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A1).
        -- assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := A2 .: Δ) (Γ := A2 .: Γ) (ξ := up_ren ξ)).
        -- apply (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A2).
        -- assumption.
    + apply typeCaseP.
      * eapply (ren_value_typing (Δ := Δ)). apply Hξ. assumption.
      * eapply (ren_comp_typing (Δ := B .: (A .: Δ)) (Γ := B .: (A .: Γ))
                                   (ξ := up_ren (up_ren ξ))).
        -- apply (up_lift_eq (A .: Γ) (A .: Δ) (up_ren ξ) (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A) B).
        -- assumption.
Qed.

Check ren_value_typing.
Check ren_comp_typing.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Tmp.All.
Require Import CBPV.ProgramContexts.
Import CommaNotation.

(* We need a type-valued simultaneous induction principle, since the
   typing judgments themselves live in [Type]. *)
Scheme vctx_typing_ind_T := Induction for vctxTyping Sort Type
  with cctx_typing_ind_T := Induction for cctxTyping Sort Type.
Combined Scheme mutindT_vctx_cctx_typing from
  vctx_typing_ind_T, cctx_typing_ind_T.

(* The type of the object that can be plugged in a hole of kind [t]:
   a value when [t = true], a computation when [t = false].  The typing
   judgment for that object is packaged in [input_typing]. *)

Definition input_typing {n: nat} (t: bool) (Delta: ctx n)
  (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
  (x: if t then value n else comp n) : Type :=
  match t as b return
    (if b then valtype else comptype) ->
    (if b then value n else comp n) -> Type
  with
  | true  => fun T v => Delta ⊩ v : T
  | false => fun T c => Delta ⊢ c : T
  end T x.

(* The two simultaneous statements, parameterised over the bool index [t]. *)

Definition Pv : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m) (n: nat)
    (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) (A: valtype)
    (T: if t then valtype else comptype),
    (Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T) -> Type :=
  fun m t Gamma n Delta C A T H =>
    forall x, @input_typing n t Delta T x -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C x : A.

Definition Pc : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m) (n: nat)
    (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) (B: comptype)
    (T: if t then valtype else comptype),
    (Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T) -> Type :=
  fun m t Gamma n Delta C B T H =>
    forall x, @input_typing n t Delta T x -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C x : B.

Definition fill_typing_all : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m),
  prod
  (forall (n: nat) (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) (A: valtype)
     (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
     (H: Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T),
      @Pv m t Gamma n Delta C A T H)
  (forall (n: nat) (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) (B: comptype)
     (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
     (H: Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T),
      @Pc m t Gamma n Delta C B T H).
Proof.
  intros m t Gamma.
  apply (mutindT_vctx_cctx_typing Pv Pc).
  - (* vctxTypingHole *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 A H.
    destruct t0; simpl.
    + intros x Hx. exact Hx.
    + destruct H.
  - (* vctxTypingPairL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A1 A2 v vrec IH v1 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typePair.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact v1.
  - (* vctxTypingPairR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A1 A2 v v0 vrec IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typePair.
    + exact v0.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* vctxTypingInj *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A1 A2 b vrec IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeSum. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* vctxTypingThunk *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C B A c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeThunk. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingHole *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 A H.
    destruct t0; simpl.
    + destruct H.
    + intros x Hx. exact Hx.
  - (* cctxTypingLambda *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' B c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeLambda. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingForce *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C B A' v IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeForce. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingAppL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' B v c IH v0 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeApp.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact v0.
  - (* cctxTypingAppR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta c C A A' B c0 v IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeApp.
    + exact c0.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingTupleL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C B1 B2 A c c0 IH c1 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeTuple.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact c1.
  - (* cctxTypingTupleR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C B1 B2 A c c0 c1 IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeTuple.
    + exact c0.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingRet *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' v IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeRet. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingLetinL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' B c c0 IH c1 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeLetin.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact c1.
  - (* cctxTypingLetinR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' B c c0 c1 IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeLetin.
    + exact c0.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingProj *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A B1 B2 b c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeProj. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCaseZ *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' v IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseZ. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSV *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B c1 c2 v IH h1 h2 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact h1.
    + exact h2.
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B v c2 hv c IH h2 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact hv.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact h2.
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B v c1 hv h1 c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact hv.
    + exact h1.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCasePV *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B c v IH hc x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseP.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hc.
  - (* cctxTypingCasePC *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B v hv c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseP.
    + exact hv.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
Defined.

Lemma fillc_typing_false : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: cctx false m n) (B: comptype) (A: comptype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; A ->
  forall (c: comp n), Delta ⊢ c : A -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C c : B.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C B A H c Hc.
  exact (snd (fill_typing_all m false Gamma) n Delta C B A H c Hc).
Qed.

Lemma fillc_typing_true : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: cctx true m n) (B: comptype) (A: valtype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; A ->
  forall (v: value n), Delta ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C v : B.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C B A H v Hv.
  exact (snd (fill_typing_all m true Gamma) n Delta C B A H v Hv).
Qed.

Lemma fillv_typing_true : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: vctx true m n) (A: valtype) (T: valtype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T ->
  forall (v: value n), Delta ⊩ v : T -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C v : A.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C A T H v Hv.
  exact (fst (fill_typing_all m true Gamma) n Delta C A T H v Hv).
Qed.

Lemma fillv_typing_false : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: vctx false m n) (A: valtype) (T: comptype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T ->
  forall (c: comp n), Delta ⊢ c : T -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C c : A.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C A T H c Hc.
  exact (fst (fill_typing_all m false Gamma) n Delta C A T H c Hc).
Qed.

Lemma fillc_typing_closing : forall n (Gamma: ctx n) (C: cctx false 0 n)
  (G: groundtype) (A: comptype),
  null [[ Gamma ]] ⊢ C : F G ; A ->
  forall (c: comp n), Gamma ⊢ c : A -> (null ⊢ fillc C c : F G).
Proof.
  intros n Gamma C G A H c Hc.
  apply fillc_typing_false with (Delta := Gamma).
  exact H.
  exact Hc.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Tmp.All.
Require Import CBPV.ProgramContexts.
Import CommaNotation.

(* We need a type-valued simultaneous induction principle, since the
   typing judgments themselves live in [Type]. *)
Scheme vctx_typing_ind_T := Induction for vctxTyping Sort Type
  with cctx_typing_ind_T := Induction for cctxTyping Sort Type.
Combined Scheme mutindT_vctx_cctx_typing from
  vctx_typing_ind_T, cctx_typing_ind_T.

(* The type of the object that can be plugged in a hole of kind [t]:
   a value when [t = true], a computation when [t = false].  The typing
   judgment for that object is packaged in [input_typing]. *)

Definition input_typing {n: nat} (t: bool) (Delta: ctx n)
  (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
  (x: if t then value n else comp n) : Type :=
  match t as b return
    (if b then valtype else comptype) ->
    (if b then value n else comp n) -> Type
  with
  | true  => fun T v => Delta ⊩ v : T
  | false => fun T c => Delta ⊢ c : T
  end T x.

(* The two simultaneous statements, parameterised over the bool index [t]. *)

Definition Pv : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m) (n: nat)
    (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) (A: valtype)
    (T: if t then valtype else comptype),
    (Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T) -> Type :=
  fun m t Gamma n Delta C A T H =>
    forall x, @input_typing n t Delta T x -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C x : A.

Definition Pc : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m) (n: nat)
    (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) (B: comptype)
    (T: if t then valtype else comptype),
    (Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T) -> Type :=
  fun m t Gamma n Delta C B T H =>
    forall x, @input_typing n t Delta T x -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C x : B.

Definition fill_typing_all : forall (m: nat) (t: bool) (Gamma: ctx m),
  prod
  (forall (n: nat) (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) (A: valtype)
     (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
     (H: Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T),
      @Pv m t Gamma n Delta C A T H)
  (forall (n: nat) (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) (B: comptype)
     (T: if t then valtype else comptype)
     (H: Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T),
      @Pc m t Gamma n Delta C B T H).
Proof.
  intros m t Gamma.
  apply (mutindT_vctx_cctx_typing Pv Pc).
  - (* vctxTypingHole *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 A H.
    destruct t0; simpl.
    + intros x Hx. exact Hx.
    + destruct H.
  - (* vctxTypingPairL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A1 A2 v vrec IH v1 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typePair.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact v1.
  - (* vctxTypingPairR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A1 A2 v v0 vrec IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typePair.
    + exact v0.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* vctxTypingInj *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A1 A2 b vrec IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeSum. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* vctxTypingThunk *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C B A c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeThunk. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingHole *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 A H.
    destruct t0; simpl.
    + destruct H.
    + intros x Hx. exact Hx.
  - (* cctxTypingLambda *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' B c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeLambda. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingForce *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C B A' v IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeForce. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingAppL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' B v c IH v0 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeApp.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact v0.
  - (* cctxTypingAppR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta c C A A' B c0 v IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeApp.
    + exact c0.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingTupleL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C B1 B2 A c c0 IH c1 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeTuple.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact c1.
  - (* cctxTypingTupleR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C B1 B2 A c c0 c1 IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeTuple.
    + exact c0.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingRet *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' v IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeRet. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingLetinL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' B c c0 IH c1 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeLetin.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact c1.
  - (* cctxTypingLetinR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' B c c0 c1 IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeLetin.
    + exact c0.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingProj *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A B1 B2 b c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeProj. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCaseZ *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A A' v IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseZ. exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSV *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B c1 c2 v IH h1 h2 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact h1.
    + exact h2.
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSL *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B v c2 hv c IH h2 x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact hv.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact h2.
  - (* cctxTypingCaseSR *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B v c1 hv h1 c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseS.
    + exact hv.
    + exact h1.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
  - (* cctxTypingCasePV *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B c v IH hc x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseP.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
    + exact hc.
  - (* cctxTypingCasePC *)
    intros m0 t0 Gamma0 n Delta C A1 A2 A' B v hv c IH x Hx.
    simpl. apply typeCaseP.
    + exact hv.
    + exact (IH x Hx).
Defined.

Lemma fillc_typing_false : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: cctx false m n) (B: comptype) (A: comptype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; A ->
  forall (c: comp n), Delta ⊢ c : A -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C c : B.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C B A H c Hc.
  exact (snd (fill_typing_all m false Gamma) n Delta C B A H c Hc).
Qed.

Lemma fillc_typing_true : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: cctx true m n) (B: comptype) (A: valtype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; A ->
  forall (v: value n), Delta ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ fillc C v : B.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C B A H v Hv.
  exact (snd (fill_typing_all m true Gamma) n Delta C B A H v Hv).
Qed.

Lemma fillv_typing_true : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: vctx true m n) (A: valtype) (T: valtype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T ->
  forall (v: value n), Delta ⊩ v : T -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C v : A.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C A T H v Hv.
  exact (fst (fill_typing_all m true Gamma) n Delta C A T H v Hv).
Qed.

Lemma fillv_typing_false : forall m n (Gamma: ctx m) (Delta: ctx n)
  (C: vctx false m n) (A: valtype) (T: comptype),
  Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T ->
  forall (c: comp n), Delta ⊢ c : T -> Gamma ⊩ fillv C c : A.
Proof.
  intros m n Gamma Delta C A T H c Hc.
  exact (fst (fill_typing_all m false Gamma) n Delta C A T H c Hc).
Qed.

Lemma fillc_typing_closing : forall n (Gamma: ctx n) (C: cctx false 0 n)
  (G: groundtype) (A: comptype),
  null [[ Gamma ]] ⊢ C : F G ; A ->
  forall (c: comp n), Gamma ⊢ c : A -> (null ⊢ fillc C c : F G).
Proof.
  intros n Gamma C G A H c Hc.
  apply fillc_typing_false with (Delta := Gamma).
  exact H.
  exact Hc.
Qed.

Excellent! The renaming lemmas compile. Now we can write the substitution typing lemmas. Since they are mutually recursive over typing derivations, and the lifting requires up_value_value typing.

First prove:
```
Lemma up_value_value_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (A: valtype) (Hσ: forall i, Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)), (A .: Γ) ⊩ up_value_value σ i : (A .: Δ) i.
```
Proof: intro i; destruct i as [i|]; simpl.
- Some i: goal `(A .: Γ) ⊩ ren_value shift (σ i) : (A .: Δ) (Some i)` which reduces to `Δ i`. `up_value_value σ (Some i) = ren_value shift (σ i)` by definition (scons with Some). `simpl` should reduce up_value_value and the context cons. Need `(A .: Γ) ⊩ ren_value shift (σ i) : Δ i`. Use ren_value_typing with Γ0 := A .: Γ, Δ0 := Γ, ξ := shift, Hξ : forall j, Γ j = (A .: Γ) (shift j) = (A .: Γ) (Some j) = Γ j. reflexivity. H := Hσ i : Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i. Conclusion `(A .: Γ) ⊩ ren_value shift (σ i) : Δ i`. Good.

- None: goal (A .: Γ) ⊩ var_value None : A. `up_value_value σ None = var_value zero = var_value None`. `typeVar`.

So:
```
Lemma up_value_value_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (A: valtype) (Hσ: forall i, Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)), (A .: Γ) ⊩ up_value_value σ i : (A .: Δ) i.
Proof.
  intros [i|]; simpl.
  - eapply (@ren_value_typing n (S n) (A .: Γ) Γ shift). 
    + intros j; reflexivity.
    + eassumption.
  - apply typeVar.
Qed.
```
Wait ren_value_typing's signature order: {m n} Γ Δ ξ Hξ v A H. Here m0 = n (domain of shift), n0 = S n (codomain). Γ0 = A .: Γ : ctx (S n). Δ0 = Γ : ctx n. ξ = shift : fin n -> fin (S n). Hξ : forall i : fin n, Γ i = (A .: Γ) (shift i) = Γ i. Then v := σ i : value n, A0 := Δ i. H := Hσ i : Δ0 ⊩ v : A0 i.e. Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i. Conclusion: (A .: Γ) ⊩ ren_value shift (σ i) : Δ i. 

But careful: `up_value_value σ (Some i)` reduces to `ren_value shift (σ i)`; after `intros [i|]; simpl`, the goal maybe `(A .: Γ) ⊩ up_value_value σ (Some i) : (A .: Δ) (Some i)`. `simpl` reduces up_value_value? `up_value_value` is a Definition `scons (var_value zero) (funcomp (ren_value shift) sigma)`. scons on Some i reduces to `(funcomp (ren_value shift) sigma) i` = ren_value shift (sigma i). simpl should. And `(A .: Δ) (Some i)` = Δ i. Good.

Now, the substitution typing Fixpoint. It requires lifting Hσ. We'll use up_value_value_typing.

Define:
```
Fixpoint subst_value_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (Hσ: forall i, Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i) (v: value m) (A: valtype)
  (H: Δ ⊩ v : A) {struct H} : Γ ⊩ subst_value σ v : A
with subst_comp_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (Hσ: forall i, Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i) (c: comp m) (B: comptype)
  (H: Δ ⊢ c : B) {struct H} : Γ ⊢ subst_comp σ c : B.
```

But the required lemma signatures are:
```
Lemma subst_value_typing : forall m n (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (Hσ: forall i, Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i) (v: value m) (A: valtype),
  Δ ⊩ v : A -> Γ ⊩ subst_value σ v : A.
```
Note m n are explicit (forall m n). Our Fixpoint has {m n} implicit. The resulting lemma from a Fixpoint with implicit m n would have implicit m n, differing from the required signature. Definition Raw_star (c c': comp 0) : Prop :=
  forall v, c >* ret v <-> c' >* ret v.

Lemma Raw_star_refl c : Raw_star c c.
Proof. intros v. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma Raw_star_sym c c' : Raw_star c c' -> Raw_star c' c.
Proof. intros H v. symmetry. apply H. Qed.

Lemma Raw_star_trans c c' c'' : Raw_star c c' -> Raw_star c' c'' -> Raw_star c c''.
Proof. intros H1 H2 v. transitivity (c' >* ret v); [apply H1|apply H2]. Qed.

Lemma CRel0_F_ground_raw_star (G: groundtype) (c c': comp 0) :
  CRel0 (F (to_valtype G)) c c' -> Raw_star c c'.
Proof.
  intros (H1 & H2) v. split; intro Hv.
  - apply star_ret_bigstep in Hv.
    destruct (H1 v Hv) as (v' & Hv' & HV).
    apply star_ret_bigstep.

    destruct (H2 v Hv) as (v' & Hv' & HV).
    apply star_ret_bigstep.
    rewrite (symmetry (SVRel_ground_eq G v' v HV)). exact Hv'.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros H. apply CRel0_F_ground_raw_star in H. exact H.

| stepProj (c c': comp n)  b: c > c' -> proj b c > proj b c'
| stepLetin (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 > c1' -> $ <- c1; c2 > $ <- c1'; c2

| ectxHole : ectx

| ectxProj : bool -> ectx -> ectx
| ectxLetin : ectx -> comp (S n) -> ectx.

  match K with
  | ectxHole => c
  | ectxApp K v => (fill K c) v
  | ectxProj b K => proj b (fill K c)
  | ectxLetin K c' => letin (fill K c) c'

| stepApp (c c': comp n) v: c > c' -> c v > c' v
| stepProj (c c': comp n)  b: c > c' -> proj b c > proj b c'
| stepLetin (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 > c1' -> $ <- c1; c2 > $ <- c1'; c2
where "A > B" := (step A B).

Notation "A >* B" := (star step A B) (at level 60).

Notation "A >+ B" := (plus step A B) (at level 60).

Inductive ectx {n: nat}: Type :=
| ectxHole : ectx
| ectxApp : ectx -> value n -> ectx
| ectxProj : bool -> ectx -> ectx
| ectxLetin : ectx -> comp (S n) -> ectx.

Fixpoint fill {n: nat} (K: ectx) (c: comp n) :=
  match K with
  | ectxHole => c
  | ectxApp K v => (fill K c) v
  | ectxProj b K => proj b (fill K c)
  | ectxLetin K c' => letin (fill K c) c'
  end.

Inductive cstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| contextStep C c c' (c'' c''': comp n):
    c ≽ c' -> fill C c = c'' -> fill C c' = c''' -> c'' ⇝ c'''
where "A '⇝' B" := (cstep A B).

(* Bigstep equivalence and transfer *)
Definition BSim (c c': comp 0) : Prop := forall r, c ▷ r <-> c' ▷ r.

Lemma BSim_refl c : BSim c c.
Proof. intros r. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma BSim_sym c c' : BSim c c' -> BSim c' c.
Proof. intros H r. symmetry. apply H. Qed.

Lemma BSim_trans c c' c'' : BSim c c' -> BSim c' c'' -> BSim c c''.
Proof. intros H1 H2 r. transitivity (c' ▷ r); [apply H1|apply H2]. Qed.

Lemma BSim_app c c' v : BSim c c' -> BSim (c v) (c' v).
Proof.
  intros H r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr; subst. eapply bigstepApp.
    + apply H. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hr; subst. eapply bigstepApp.
    + apply H. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma BSim_proj c c' b : BSim c c' -> BSim (proj b c) (proj b c').
Proof.
  intros H r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr; subst. eapply bigstepProj.
    + apply H. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hr; subst. eapply bigstepProj.
    + apply H. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma BSim_force_thunk (d: comp 0) : BSim (force (thunk d)) d.
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr. assumption.
  - eapply bigstepForce. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma BSim_proj_tuple b (c1 c2: comp 0) :
  BSim (proj b (tuple c1 c2)) (if b then c1 else c2).
Proof.
  intros r. split; intro Hr.
  - inversion Hr; subst. match goal with Hf : tuple _ _ ▷ _ |- _ => inversion Hf; subst end. eassumption.

    + apply bigstepTuple.
    + exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma BSim_app_lambda (c0: comp 1) (v: value 0) :
  BSim (app (lambda c0) v) (c0[v..]).
Proof.

(* Bigstep equivalence and transfer *)
Definition BSim (c c': comp 0) : Prop := forall r, c ▷ r <-> c' ▷ r.

Lemma BSim_refl c : BSim c c.
Proof. intros r. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma BSim_sym c c' : BSim c c' -> BSim c' c.
Proof. intros H r. symmetry. apply H. Qed.

Lemma BSim_trans c c' c'' : BSim c c' -> BSim c' c'' -> BSim c c''.
Proof. intros H1 H2 r. transitivity (c' ▷ r); [apply H1|apply H2]. Qed.

Proof.
  intros H r. split; intro Hr.

    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hr; subst. eapply bigstepApp.
    + apply H. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
Qed.

Proof.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Tmp.All.
Require Import CBPV.ObservationalEquivalence CBPV.StrongReduction CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems.
Import CommaNotation.
Typeclasses Transparent Subst_comp Subst_value.

Lemma up_lift_eq {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (A: valtype) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)), (A .: Δ) i = (A .: Γ) (up_ren ξ i).
Proof.
  intros i. destruct i as [i|]; simpl.
  - change (Δ i = Γ (ξ i)). apply Hξ.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_value_typing (m n : nat) (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (v: value m) (A: valtype)
  (H: Δ ⊩ v : A) {struct H} : Γ ⊩ ren_value ξ v : A
with ren_comp_typing (m n : nat) (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (ξ: fin m -> fin n)
  (Hξ: forall i, Δ i = Γ (ξ i)) (c: comp m) (B: comptype)
  (H: Δ ⊢ c : B) {struct H} : Γ ⊢ ren_comp ξ c : B.
Proof.
  - (* value *) simpl.
    destruct H; simpl.
    + (* typeVar *)
      exact (match eq_sym (Hξ i) in (_ = T') return (Γ ⊩ var_value (ξ i) : T') with
             | eq_refl => @typeVar _ Γ (ξ i)
             end).
    + apply typeUnit.
    + apply typePair.
      * eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
      * eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
    + apply typeSum.
      eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
    + apply typeThunk.
      eapply (@ren_comp_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
  - (* comp *) simpl.
    destruct H; simpl.
    + (* typeCone *) apply typeCone.
    + (* typeLambda *) apply typeLambda.
      eapply (@ren_comp_typing (S m) (S n) (A .: Γ) (A .: Δ) (up_ren ξ)
                                 (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A)).
      eassumption.
    + (* typeLetin *) eapply typeLetin.
      * eapply (@ren_comp_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
      * eapply (@ren_comp_typing (S m) (S n) (A .: Γ) (A .: Δ) (up_ren ξ)
                                   (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A)).
        eassumption.
    + (* typeRet *) apply typeRet.
      eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
    + (* typeApp *) eapply typeApp.
      * eapply (@ren_comp_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
      * eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
    + (* typeTuple *) eapply typeTuple.
      * eapply (@ren_comp_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
      * eapply (@ren_comp_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
    + (* typeProj *) eapply typeProj.
      eapply (@ren_comp_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
    + (* typeForce *) apply typeForce.
      eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
    + (* typeCaseZ *) apply typeCaseZ.
      eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
    + (* typeCaseS *) eapply typeCaseS.
      * eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
      * eapply (@ren_comp_typing (S m) (S n) (A1 .: Γ) (A1 .: Δ) (up_ren ξ)
                                   (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A1)).
        eassumption.
      * eapply (@ren_comp_typing (S m) (S n) (A2 .: Γ) (A2 .: Δ) (up_ren ξ)
                                   (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A2)).
        eassumption.
    + (* typeCaseP *) eapply typeCaseP.
      * eapply (@ren_value_typing m n Γ Δ ξ Hξ). eassumption.
      * eapply (@ren_comp_typing (S (S m)) (S (S n)) (B .: (A .: Γ)) (B .: (A .: Δ))
                                   (up_ren (up_ren ξ))
                                   (up_lift_eq (A .: Γ) (A .: Δ) (up_ren ξ)
                                               (up_lift_eq Γ Δ ξ Hξ A) B)).
        eassumption.
Qed.

Check ren_value_typing.
Check ren_comp_typing.

Lemma up_value_value_typing {m n} (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (A: valtype) (Hσ: forall i, Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)), (A .: Γ) ⊩ up_value_value σ i : (A .: Δ) i.
Proof.
  intros [i|]; simpl.
  - eapply (@ren_value_typing n (S n) (A .: Γ) Γ shift).
    + intros j. reflexivity.
    + eapply Hσ.
  - apply typeVar.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_value_typing (m n : nat) (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (Hσ: forall i, Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i) (v: value m) (A: valtype)
  (H: Δ ⊩ v : A) {struct H} : Γ ⊩ subst_value σ v : A
with subst_comp_typing (m n : nat) (Γ: ctx n) (Δ: ctx m) (σ: fin m -> value n)
  (Hσ: forall i, Γ ⊩ σ i : Δ i) (c: comp m) (B: comptype)
  (H: Δ ⊢ c : B) {struct H} : Γ ⊢ subst_comp σ c : B.
Proof.
  - (* value *) simpl. destruct H; simpl.
    + (* typeVar *) exact (Hσ i).
    + apply typeUnit.
    + apply typePair.
      * eapply (@subst_value_typing m n Γ Δ σ Hσ). eassumption.
      * eapply (@subst_value_typing m n Γ Δ σ Hσ). eassumption.
    + apply typeSum.
      eapply (@subst_value_typing m n Γ Δ σ Hσ). eassumption.
    + apply typeThunk.
      eapply (@subst_comp_typing m n Γ Δ σ Hσ). eassumption.
  - (* comp *) simpl. destruct H; simpl.
    + (* typeCone *) apply typeCone.
    + (* typeLambda *) apply typeLambda.
      eapply (@subst_comp_typing (S m) (S n) (A .: Γ) (A .: Δ)
                                   (up_value_value σ) (@up_value_value_typing m n Γ Δ σ A Hσ)).
      eassumption.
    + (* typeLetin *) eapply typeLetin.
      * eapply (@subst_comp_typing m n Γ Δ σ Hσ). eassumption.
      * eapply (@subst_comp_typing (S m) (S n) (A .: Γ) (A .: Δ)
                                     (up_value_value σ) (@up_value_value_typing m n Γ Δ σ A Hσ)).

Definition SVRel_typed (A:valtype) (V:value 0) (H: null ⊩ V : A) : SVRel A V V.
Proof.
  pose (c0 := (fun i : fin 0 => match i with end) : ctx 0).
  pose (e := (fun i : fin 0 => match i with end) : fin 0 -> value 0).
  pose proof (@fund_val 0 c0 V A H
    e e (fun i : fin 0 => match i with end)) as Hf.
  refine (eq_ind (subst_value e V)
            (fun x => SVRel A V x) _ V (subst_value_null V e)).
  refine (eq_ind (subst_value e V)
            (fun x => SVRel A x (subst_value e V)) _ V (subst_value_null V e)).
  exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma up_value_value_congr {m n} {sigma tau : fin m -> value n}
  (H : forall (i : fin m), sigma i = tau i) :
  forall (i : fin (S m)), up_value_value sigma i = up_value_value tau i.

  intros i. destruct i as [x|].
  - cbn [up_value_value scons funcomp].
    change (ren_value shift (sigma x) = ren_value shift (tau x)).

  (H: Γ ⊢ tuple c1 c2 : B) (P: Prop)

Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export CBPV.Terms CBPV.Base CBPV.Semantics.

Import CommaNotation.

Reserved Notation "Gamma ⊢ c : A" (at level 80, c at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Gamma ⊩ v : A" (at level 80, v at level 99).

Definition ctx (n: nat) := fin n -> valtype.

Inductive value_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : value m -> valtype -> Type :=
| typeVar i : Gamma ⊩ var_value i : Gamma i
| typeUnit: Gamma ⊩ u : one
| typePair v1 v2 A1 A2:
    Gamma ⊩ v1 : A1 -> Gamma ⊩ v2 : A2 -> Gamma ⊩ pair v1 v2 : cross A1 A2
| typeSum A1 A2 (b: bool) v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : (if b then A1 else A2) -> Gamma ⊩ inj b v : Sigma A1 A2
| typeThunk c A:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A -> Gamma ⊩ thunk c : U A
where "Gamma ⊩ v : A" := (value_typing Gamma v A)


with computation_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : comp m -> comptype -> Type :=
| typeCone: Gamma ⊢ cu : cone
| typeLambda (c: comp (S m)) A B:
    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B -> (Gamma ⊢ lambda c : A → B)
| typeLetin c1 c2 A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : F A -> A .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B -> Gamma ⊢ $ <- c1; c2 : B
| typeRet v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ ret v : F A
| typeApp c v A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B -> Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ c v : B
| typeTuple c1 c2 B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : B1  -> Gamma ⊢ c2 : B2 -> Gamma ⊢ tuple c1 c2 : Pi B1 B2
| typeProj b c B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c : Pi B1 B2 -> Gamma ⊢ proj b c : (if b then B1 else B2)
| typeForce v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : U A -> Gamma ⊢ v! : A
| typeCaseZ v A: Gamma ⊩ v : zero -> Gamma ⊢ caseZ v : A
| typeCaseS v c1 c2 A1 A2 C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2 ->
    A1, Gamma ⊢ c1 : C ->
    A2, Gamma ⊢ c2 : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseS v c1 c2 : C
| typeCaseP v c A B C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A * B ->
    B, A, Gamma  ⊢ c : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseP v c : C
where "Gamma ⊢ c : A" := (@computation_typing _ Gamma c A).

Require Export axioms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Type :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y)  :=
  fun x => g (f x).

Class Subst1 (X : nat -> Type) (Y : nat -> Type) :=
  subst1 : forall {m n}, (fin m -> X n) -> Y m -> Y n.

Class Ren1 (X : nat -> Type) :=
  ren1 : forall {m n}, (fin m -> fin n) -> X m -> X n.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : nat -> Type) (Y : nat -> nat -> Type) :=
  subst2 : forall {m1 m2 n1 n2}, (fin m1 -> X1 n1) -> (fin m2 -> X2 n2) -> Y m1 m2 -> Y n1 n2.

Class Ren2 (X : nat -> Type) :=
  ren2 : forall {m n}, (fin m -> fin n) -> X m -> X n.

Notation "s [ sigma ]" := (@subst1 _ _ _ _ _ sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s [ sigma ; tau ]" := (subst1  sigma tau s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ; '/'  tau ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ sigma ⟩" := (@ren1 _ _ _ _ sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' ⟨ sigma ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "[ sigma ]" := (@subst1 _ _ _ _ _ sigma) (at level 1, left associativity) : fscope.

Notation "⟨ xi ⟩" := (@ren1 _ _ _ _ xi) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi ⟩") : fscope.

Arguments funcomp {X Y Z} (g)%fscope (f)%fscope.

Open Scope subst_scope.

Definition scons {X : Type} {n : nat} (x : X) (f : fin n -> X) (m : fin (S n)) : X :=
  match m with
  | None => x
  | Some i => f i
  end.

Notation "x .: f" := (@scons _ _ x f) (at level 55) : subst_scope.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition bound {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition null {T} (i : fin 0) : T := match i with end.

Definition shift {n : nat} : ren n (S n) :=
  Some.

Definition up_ren m n (xi : ren m n) : ren (S m) (S n) :=
  bound .: xi >> shift.

Definition var_zero {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=
  fun x => x.

Definition comp := @funcomp.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Class Var (X : nat -> Type) :=
  ids : forall {m}, fin m -> X m.

Require Export SyntacticTyping.

Inductive vctx (t: bool) (m: nat): nat -> Type :=
  | vctxHole : (if t then True else False) -> vctx t m m
  | vctxPairL n: vctx t m n -> value m -> vctx t m n
  | vctxPairR n : value m -> vctx t m n -> vctx t m n
  | vctxInj n : bool -> vctx t m n -> vctx t m n
  | vctxThunk n : cctx t m n -> vctx t m n


with cctx (t: bool) (m: nat) : nat -> Type :=
  | cctxHole: (if t then False else True) -> cctx t m m
  | cctxForce n : vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLambda n: cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxAppL n:  cctx t m n -> value m -> cctx t m n
  | cctxAppR n:  comp m -> vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxTupleL n: cctx t m n -> comp m -> cctx t m n
  | cctxTupleR n: comp m -> cctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxRet n: vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLetinL n: cctx t m n -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLetinR n: comp m -> cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxProj n: bool -> cctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseZ n: vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSV n: vctx t m n -> comp (S m) -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSL n: value m -> cctx t (S m) n -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSR n: value m -> comp (S m) -> cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCasePV n: vctx t m n -> comp (S (S m)) -> cctx t m n

Scheme vctx_ind_2 := Induction for vctx Sort Prop
  with cctx_ind_2  := Induction for cctx Sort Prop.

Notation "'•__v'" := (vctxHole true _ I).

Notation "'•__c'" := (cctxHole false _ I).

Fixpoint fillv {m n: nat} {t: bool} (C: vctx t m n) : (if t then value n else comp n) -> value m :=
  match C in vctx _ _ n return (if t then value n else comp n) -> value m with
  | vctxHole _ _ H =>
    (match t return (if t then True else False) -> (if t then value m else comp m) -> value m with
    |  true => fun _ v' => v'
    | false => fun f _ => match f with end
    end) H
  | vctxPairL C v => fun v' => pair (fillv C v') v
  | vctxPairR v C => fun v' => pair v (fillv C v')
  | vctxInj b C => fun v' => inj b (fillv C v')
  | vctxThunk C => fun v' => <{ fillc C v' }>
  end
with fillc {m n: nat} {t: bool} (C: cctx t m n) : (if t then value n else comp n) -> comp m :=
  match C in cctx _ _ n return (if t then value n else comp n) -> comp m with
  | cctxHole _ _ H =>
    (match t return (if t then False else True) -> (if t then value m else comp m) -> comp m with
     | false => fun _ v' => v'
     | true => fun f _ => match f with end
     end) H
  | cctxForce C => fun v' => (fillv C v') !
  | cctxLambda C => fun v' => lambda (fillc C v')
  | cctxAppL C v => fun v' => (fillc C v') v
  | cctxAppR c C => fun v' => c (fillv C v')
  | cctxTupleL C c => fun v' => tuple (fillc C v') c
  | cctxTupleR c C => fun v' => tuple c (fillc C v')
  | cctxRet C => fun v' => ret (fillv C v')
  | cctxLetinL C c => fun v' => letin (fillc C v') c
  | cctxLetinR c C => fun v' => letin c (fillc C v')
  | cctxProj b C => fun v' => proj b (fillc C v')
  | cctxCaseZ C => fun v' => caseZ (fillv C v')
  | cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 => fun v' => caseS (fillv C v') c1 c2
  | cctxCaseSL v C c2 => fun v' => caseS v (fillc C v') c2
  | cctxCaseSR v c1 C => fun v' => caseS v c1 (fillc C v')
  | cctxCasePV C c => fun v' => caseP (fillv C v') c
  | cctxCasePC v C => fun v' => caseP v (fillc C v')
  end.

Reserved Notation "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T" (at level 53, C at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T" (at level 53,  C at level 99).

Definition valtypeif (t: bool) (A: valtype):
  (if t then True else False) -> if t then valtype else comptype :=
  match t with
  | true => fun _ => A
  | false => fun f => match f with end
  end.

Definition comptypeif (t: bool) (B: comptype):
  (if t then False else True) -> if t then valtype else comptype :=
  match t with
  | false => fun _ => B
  | true => fun f => match f with end
  end.

Inductive vctxTyping {m: nat} {t: bool} (Gamma: ctx m) :
  forall n, ctx n -> vctx t m n -> valtype -> (if t then valtype else comptype) -> Type :=
| vctxTypingHole A H:
    Gamma [[ Gamma ]] ⊩ vctxHole t m H : A; valtypeif t A H
| vctxTypingPairL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 v:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A1; A ->
    Gamma ⊩ v : A2  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxPairL C v : A1 * A2; A
| vctxTypingPairR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A1  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxPairR v C : A1 * A2; A
| vctxTypingInj n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 (b: bool):
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : (if b then A1 else A2); A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxInj b C : Sigma A1 A2; A
| vctxTypingThunk n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B A:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxThunk C : U B; A
where "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T " := (@vctxTyping _ _ Gamma _  Delta C A T)

with cctxTyping {m: nat} {t: bool} (Gamma: ctx m) :
  forall n, ctx n -> cctx t m n -> comptype -> (if t then valtype else comptype) -> Type :=
| cctxTypingHole A H:
    Gamma [[ Gamma ]] ⊢ cctxHole t m H : A; comptypeif t A H
| cctxTypingLambda n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A A' B:
    (A .: Gamma) [[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
      Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLambda C : A → B; A'
| cctxTypingForce n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) B A':
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊩ C : U B; A' ->
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxForce C : B; A'
| cctxTypingAppL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A A' B v:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : A → B; A' ->
    Gamma ⊩ v : A  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxAppL C v : B; A'
| cctxTypingAppR n (Delta: ctx n) c (C: vctx t m n) A A' B :
    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxAppR c C : B; A'
| cctxTypingTupleL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B1 B2 A c:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B1; A ->
    Gamma ⊢ c : B2  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxTupleL C c : Pi B1 B2; A
| cctxTypingTupleR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B1 B2 A c:
    Gamma ⊢ c : B1  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxTupleR c C : Pi B1 B2; A
| cctxTypingRet n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A':
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊩ C : A; A' ->
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxRet C : F A; A'
| cctxTypingLetinL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A A' B c:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : F A; A' ->
    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLetinL C c : B; A'
| cctxTypingLetinR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A A' B c:
    Gamma ⊢ c : F A  ->

    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLetinR c C : B; A'
| cctxTypingProj n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A B1 B2 (b: bool):
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : Pi B1 B2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxProj b C : (if b then B1 else B2); A

    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseZ C : A; A'
| cctxTypingCaseSV n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A1 A2 A' B c1 c2:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : Sigma A1 A2; A' ->
    A1 .: Gamma ⊢ c1 : B  ->

    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 : B; A'

Fixpoint fillv {m n: nat} {t: bool} (C: vctx t m n) : (if t then value n else comp n) -> value m :=
  match C in vctx _ _ n return (if t then value n else comp n) -> value m with
  | vctxHole _ _ H =>
    (match t return (if t then True else False) -> (if t then value m else comp m) -> value m with
    |  true => fun _ v' => v'
    | false => fun f _ => match f with end
    end) H
  | vctxPairL C v => fun v' => pair (fillv C v') v
  | vctxPairR v C => fun v' => pair v (fillv C v')
  | vctxInj b C => fun v' => inj b (fillv C v')
  | vctxThunk C => fun v' => <{ fillc C v' }>
  end
with fillc {m n: nat} {t: bool} (C: cctx t m n) : (if t then value n else comp n) -> comp m :=
  match C in cctx _ _ n return (if t then value n else comp n) -> comp m with
  | cctxHole _ _ H =>
    (match t return (if t then False else True) -> (if t then value m else comp m) -> comp m with
     | false => fun _ v' => v'
     | true => fun f _ => match f with end
     end) H
  | cctxForce C => fun v' => (fillv C v') !
  | cctxLambda C => fun v' => lambda (fillc C v')
  | cctxAppL C v => fun v' => (fillc C v') v
  | cctxAppR c C => fun v' => c (fillv C v')
  | cctxTupleL C c => fun v' => tuple (fillc C v') c
  | cctxTupleR c C => fun v' => tuple c (fillc C v')
  | cctxRet C => fun v' => ret (fillv C v')
  | cctxLetinL C c => fun v' => letin (fillc C v') c
  | cctxLetinR c C => fun v' => letin c (fillc C v')
  | cctxProj b C => fun v' => proj b (fillc C v')
  | cctxCaseZ C => fun v' => caseZ (fillv C v')
  | cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 => fun v' => caseS (fillv C v') c1 c2
  | cctxCaseSL v C c2 => fun v' => caseS v (fillc C v') c2
  | cctxCaseSR v c1 C => fun v' => caseS v c1 (fillc C v')
  | cctxCasePV C c => fun v' => caseP (fillv C v') c
  | cctxCasePC v C => fun v' => caseP v (fillc C v')
  end.

Definition valtypeif (t: bool) (A: valtype):
  (if t then True else False) -> if t then valtype else comptype :=
  match t with
  | true => fun _ => A
  | false => fun f => match f with end

  end.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Tmp.All.
(* [Require Import Tmp.All] does not re-export the CBPV library, so we
   re-require [CBPV.StrongReduction] to bring [CommaNotation] and the
   [↪] / [↪ᵥ] / [star] notations into scope. *)
Require Import CBPV.StrongReduction.
Import CommaNotation.

(* Closure of strong reduction under one-hole program contexts.

   We prove the two [true]-indexed and the two [false]-indexed statements
   by two mutual fixpoints (the [true] and [false] families cannot be
   merged, since the impossible hole constructor has a different type
   in each).  Every recursive call is on a direct constructor argument,
   so the structural guard condition is satisfied. *)

Fixpoint sstep_fillc_true_aux {m n: nat} (C: cctx true m n) {struct C} :
  forall (v v': value n), v ↪ᵥ v' -> fillc C v ↪ fillc C v'
with sstep_fillv_true_aux {m n: nat} (C: vctx true m n) {struct C} :
  forall (v v': value n), v ↪ᵥ v' -> fillv C v ↪ᵥ fillv C v'.
Proof.
  - (* cctx true *)
    destruct C as [H | n C | n C | n C v0 | n c0 C | n C c0 | n c0 C
                  | n C | n C c0 | n c0 C | n b C | n C | n C c1 c2
                  | n v0 C c2 | n v0 c1 C | n C c0 | n v0 C];
    intros v v' Hv.
    + destruct H.
    + apply sstepForce. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepLambda. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepAppL. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepAppR. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepTupleL. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepTupleR. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepRet. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepLetinL. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepLetinR. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepProj. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepCaseZ. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepCaseSV. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepCaseSL. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepCaseSR. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepCasePV. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepCasePC. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
  - (* vctx true *)
    destruct C as [H | n C v0 | n v0 C | n b C | n C]; intros v v' Hv.
    + exact Hv.
    + apply sstepValuePairL. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepValuePairR. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepValueInj. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact Hv.
    + apply sstepValueThunk. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact Hv.
Qed.

Fixpoint sstep_fillc_false_aux {m n: nat} (C: cctx false m n) {struct C} :
  forall (c c': comp n), c ↪ c' -> fillc C c ↪ fillc C c'
with sstep_fillv_false_aux {m n: nat} (C: vctx false m n) {struct C} :
  forall (c c': comp n), c ↪ c' -> fillv C c ↪ᵥ fillv C c'.
Proof.

    + apply sstepTupleR. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepRet. apply sstep_fillv_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepLetinL. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepLetinR. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepProj. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepCaseZ. apply sstep_fillv_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepCaseSV. apply sstep_fillv_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepCaseSL. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepCaseSR. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepCasePV. apply sstep_fillv_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepCasePC. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact Hc.
  - (* vctx false *)
    destruct C as [H | n C v0 | n v0 C | n b C | n C]; intros c c' Hc.
    + destruct H.
    + apply sstepValuePairL. apply sstep_fillv_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepValuePairR. apply sstep_fillv_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepValueInj. apply sstep_fillv_false_aux. exact Hc.
    + apply sstepValueThunk. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma sstep_fillc_true : forall m n (C: cctx true m n) (v v': value n),
  v ↪ᵥ v' -> fillc C v ↪ fillc C v'.
Proof.
  intros m n C v v' H. apply sstep_fillc_true_aux. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma sstep_fillc_false : forall m n (C: cctx false m n) (c c': comp n),
  c ↪ c' -> fillc C c ↪ fillc C c'.
Proof.
  intros m n C c c' H. apply sstep_fillc_false_aux. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma sstep_fillv_true : forall m n (C: vctx true m n) (v v': value n),
  v ↪ᵥ v' -> fillv C v ↪ᵥ fillv C v'.
Proof.
  intros m n C v v' H. apply sstep_fillv_true_aux. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma sstep_fillv_false : forall m n (C: vctx false m n) (c c': comp n),
  c ↪ c' -> fillv C c ↪ᵥ fillv C c'.
Proof.
  intros m n C c c' H. apply sstep_fillv_false_aux. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma sstep_star_fillc_false : forall m n (C: cctx false m n) (c c': comp n),
  star sstep c c' -> star sstep (fillc C c) (fillc C c').
Proof.
  intros m n C c c' H. induction H.
  - apply starRefl.
  - eapply starStep.
    + apply sstep_fillc_false. exact H.
    + exact IHstar.
Qed.

Lemma sstep_star_fillc_true : forall m n (C: cctx true m n) (v v': value n),
  star sstep_value v v' -> star sstep (fillc C v) (fillc C v').
Proof.
  intros m n C v v' H. induction H.
  - apply starRefl.
  - eapply starStep.
    + apply sstep_fillc_true. exact H.
    + exact IHstar.
Qed.

Lemma sstep_star_fillv_false : forall m n (C: vctx false m n) (c c': comp n),
  star sstep c c' -> star sstep_value (fillv C c) (fillv C c').
Proof.
  intros m n C c c' H. induction H.
  - apply starRefl.
  - eapply starStep.
    + apply sstep_fillv_false. exact H.
    + exact IHstar.
Qed.

Lemma sstep_star_fillv_true : forall m n (C: vctx true m n) (v v': value n),
  star sstep_value v v' -> star sstep_value (fillv C v) (fillv C v').
Proof.
  intros m n C v v' H. induction H.
  - apply starRefl.
  - eapply starStep.
    + apply sstep_fillv_true. exact H.
    + exact IHstar.
Qed.
